tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bar do spyi'i don thams cad rnam pa gsal bar byed pa dran pa'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ gdon nas rab dag dag pa gnyis ldan srid dang zhi ba'i spros pa kun bral chos kyi sku// rang mdangs ma 'gags 'gag med 'char tshul zhi dang khro gar ye shes lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs// sna tshogs 'gro 'dul 'dul zhing gang 'tshams sprul bsgyur bgrang yas 'dod 'byung mdzod mnga' sprul pa'i sku// dbyer med bla ma ma lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag rang rig gnyis med mchod// 'khor 'das snang srid gdod nas yongs dag pa'i// gshis ngor skye 'chi bde sdug ming dben kyang*// ma rtogs blo la 'khrul snang mtha' med kyi// sbubs chud sdug bsngal mang myong snying rje'i gnas// de dag thabs mang du mas bsgral slad chos// zab cing rgya cher mnga' las snying po'i bcud// mchog gyur bar do'i gdams pa bsam yas kyang*// sgrub brgyud gong ma rnams kyis gsal mdzad mod// de dag las lhag rmongs pa bdag 'dra yis// brjod du ci mchis brjod kyang dgos pa gang*// 'on kyang blo dang ldan pa khyed nyid kyis// dris phyir gong ma rnams gsung bskyar bzhin brjod/ ༈ /de yang spyir sems can thams cad thog ma'i 'khrul gzhi las brtsams te/ mthar thug byang chub mngon du ma gyur gyi bar thams cad nams kyang bar ma do'i gnas skabs kho na'i phyir/ gzhi lam gyi chos thams cad bar do'i tha snyad gdags su rung ba kho na yin na'ang*/ tha mal pa dag bar srid kyi gnas skabs gcig pu kho na la bar do zhes sdug sdug pa gcig tu 'dzin la/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i bar do thos grol gyi gdams pa sogs su bar do'i rnam grangs drug tu 'dren pa'i skabs kyi nang tshan las/ ting nge 'dzin bsam gtan gyi bar do zhes pa 'di la/ phyis byon gyi mkhas pa la la'i thugs su ma shong bar dgag pa sna tshogs mdzad pa snang mod kyang*/

'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bar do'i rang bzhin yin na/ bsam gtan kyang bar do ru ci'i phyir mi rung bar byed/ 'dir ma zad rje mi las/ mkha' 'gro bkra shis tshe ring ma la gnang ba'i bar do 'phrang sgrol du'ang spyir bar do drug tu 'dren tshul dang*/ sgos su bsam gtan ting nge 'dzin gyi bar do'i rnam gzhag mdzad lugs kyang thos grol dang tha mi dad pa de bzhin yin tshe/ gsar rnying dgongs bzhed mthun la/ spyir bar do'i rnam grangs 'dren tshul la gzhung mtha' dag so sor mi gcig pa du ma 'byung ste/ rang bzhin skye gnas/ 'chi kha sdug bsngal/ chos nyid srid pa ste bar do gsum du mdzad pa dang*/ yang zung 'jug sku bzhi/ rang rig ye shes/ dus mtshams rang bzhin/ 'chugs med rten 'brel gyi bar do dang bzhir mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang skye gnas/ rmi lam/ bsam gtan/ 'chi kha/ chos nyid/ srid pa'i bar do dang drug tu mdzad pa dang bcas pa sogs lugs mang mod kyi/ re zhig skabs 'dir ni/ nyid kyis dris pa'i mthus gsar rnying thun mong ltar gyi 'gag don bsdus te rtogs bde ba'i slad du/ rang bzhin skye gnas kyi bar do dang*/ 'chi kha sdug bsngal gyi bar do dang*/ chos nyid 'od gsal gyi bar do dang*/ srid pa las kyi bar do ste/ de ltar rnam pa bzhir bsdus nas bstan par bya zhing*/ de dag re re la'ang ngo bo ngos bzung ba/ 'char tshul rgyas par bshad pa/ gdams ngag lam du bya ba dang gsum gyis 'chad do/ ༈ /dang po la skye gnas kyi bar do zhes gang la zer ce na/ ma'i mngal nas byung ba nas mthar 'chi rkyen gyis ma zin pa'i bar 'di la zer/ 'char tshul lam snang gang lta bu zhe na/ gang zag mchog dman gyi khyad par tha dad pa'i dbang gis so sor snang ba ste/ de yang mchog rab kyi skal ldan dag la ni/ snang grags lha sngags su shes pas snod bcud dkyil 'khor du lhun gyis grub cing*/ rtog tshogs chos nyid kyi rol par shar bas thams cad sku gsum gyi rang bzhin nyid du ye nas kyang yin la/

da lta yang snang*/ mthar yang de'i ngang du grol phyir snang srid dag pa rab 'byams sam/ cir snang ye shes kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ste/ tshul 'di la ni dpal mkha' spyod zhabs sogs kyis zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bar do dang*/ rang rig ye shes kyi bar do sogs su ming gdags par mdzad cing*/ sngar bshad pa'i ting 'dzin bsam gtan gyi bar do yang 'di'i khongs su 'du bas logs su brjod ma dgos la/ de ltar ma rtogs ma rig pa'i tha mal pa'i gang zag rnams ni skyes nas 'chi nad ma thebs pa'i bar de srid kun tu bag chags ngan goms 'khrul snang a 'thas kyi rjes su 'brang ste/ mi bden pa la bden par 'dzin/ mi rtag pa la rtag tu re/ sdug bsngal ba bde bar 'khrul zhing zhen pas/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong*/ nga khyod chags sdang*/ ma zin ma chog /bsags srung 'tsho skyong*/ 'jig rten chos brgyad/ don med 'khrul zhen gyi bya ba kho nas mi tshe stong zad du phyal gyis gtong ba 'di lta bur skye 'gro phal mo che'i snang tshul gyi chos nyid yin tshe/ skye gnas bar do'i rang bzhin ni 'di las ma 'das shing*/ de skabs kyi mtshan mo sogs kyang man ngag gi gnad kyis ma zin pa'i gti mug ro nyal bsam med dud 'gro lta bur gyur pa dang*/ de la'ang nying 'khrul rmi lam gyi snang ba sna tshogs pas bskyed cing gzings phyir/ bag chags rmi lam gyi bar do yang skye gnas bar do'i khongs 'dir 'du ba nyid do// ji skad du/ 'phags pa dkon mchog 'byung gi mdo las/ log par rtog la chags pa'i dbang gis ni// 'dir ni 'gro ba 'di kun rab tu 'khyams// skyes bu gang zhig zhi ba'i chos rigs pa// des ni rang byung de bzhin gshegs pa mthong*// chos mchog zhi ba rnams kyang rab tu shes// zhes gsungs pa ltar rtogs ma rtogs kyi khyad par shin tu che'o// skye gnas bar do 'di lam du khyer thabs gdams ngag gi rim pa ni/ rnying lugs kyi man ngag dag las thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa thi bya tshang 'jug lta bu'i gdams pa la 'bad ces gsungs shing*/

de ji ltar bya na/ dang por bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa btsal/ snying nas sgo gsum zol med kyis mnyes pa'i thabs du mas bsten/ bstan pa'i gzhi ma'am lam gyi srog shing sdom pa gsum legs par mnos la/ nyams chags nyes ltung gi dri ma phra mos kyang ma gos par bsrung*/ mdo rgyud theg pa'i rim pa mtha' dag la thos bsam phyogs med du byas nas/ grub mtha'i zhen phyogs spang*/ ha cang thos pa la zhen cing 'byams na tha snyad tshig mthar 'khor nas don gyi snying po mi lon pas/ gang thos rang gi rgyud la bkal/ thos bsam thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i man ngag kho nar 'dus phyir gdams ngag mthil phyin par zhun thar bcad/ mi tshe stong zad du 'gro ba'i rgyu ni 'jig rten gyi bya ba ma thong pa nyid las 'byung bas/ tshe 'di'i zhen 'khris rbad kyis bcad la dben pa'i ri khrod 'grim/ dben par bsdad kyang sgo gsum dge ba la ma brtson na bya dang ri dwags gcan gzan gyi tshogs dang 'dra bas tha mal snyom las chos min gyi dbang du skad cig kyang mi btang bar 'gyod med gding thob bya/ stong nyid kyi don rtogs kyang bslu med rgyu 'bras rten 'brel la yid ches nges shes brtan pos dge sdig khyad gsod du ma song bar rgyal ba'i bka' dang mthun pa'i lta spyod zung 'brel la bslab/ ༈ khyad par bar do 'og ma thams cad kyi gnad 'gag 'dir rag las phyir/ skye gnas bar do long khyab yod pa'i dus 'dir nyams len goms shugs dang ldan par ma gyur na/ long med 'chi rkyen gyi gag la thug tshe 'gyod kyang 'phyis tshar te/ o rgyan rin po ches/ long yod po tsho 'chi khar sprad sprad byed// a re 'gyod de bag tsam 'phyis pa 'dra// zhes gsung pa ltar 'byung bas/ des na bar do da lta nas sbyang ba gal che ba nyid kyi phyir/ gang zag so so'i skal pa dang mos par mthun pa'i chos sgo gang dang gang la zhugs pa de dang de'i gdams pa nyams su blangs nas rgyud smin grol du bya dgos tshe/

thog mar smin byed dbang gi rim pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs thob nges su bya/ dbang de yang deng sang snyigs dus kyi slob dpon so so'i dbang chog bskur thob kyi tshul phal cher ni rgyud sde dang rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi bka' srol dang mthun pa ni ches dkon par gyur te/ bla mas kyang zang zing bsdu thabs sam khe grags sogs kyi slad du dbang bskur byed pa mang zhing*/ slob ma zhu ba po rnams kyis kyang 'phral rkyen nad gdon sogs la phan du re ba'am/ mi chos dang zla grogs kyi zhor dang*/ ltad mo'am ci byed lta ba lta bu'i bsam pa'i sgo nas zhu tshul byed pa las/ yang dag gi dad pa'i dngos po dang mi ldan zhing*/ dbang don ngo 'phrod pa'i phyogs tsam yang mi srid pa lta bur snang tshe/ mdor na dpon slob gnyis kas dbang gi zol dang byis rtsed lad mo byed pa 'dra ba 'di lta bus ni/ gang zag gi rgyud smin nus pa'i thabs mi 'dug pas mngon sum du gsal mod/ snod bcud tshul ldan 'dzom pa zhig la ni/ kun rdzob kyi dbang rdzas rnams mgo bor bzhag kyang rung*/ ma bzhag kyang rung ste/ dbang don gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes na yang dag pa'i dbang thob pa'i mchog tu gyur pa ste/ tai lo pas nā ro la phyag lham 'phangs pas brgyal ba las sangs tshe/ dbang don mthar thug rtogs pa'i tshul dang*/ paṇa chen shrī seng has/ mkhas pa bai ro la shing tog ku shu gcig sbyin pa'i brda thabs kyis rdzogs chen rig pa'i rtsal dbang yongs rdzogs thob pa dang*/ gzhan yang skyo ston bsod nams bla mas ma cig lab sgron la dbang bskur dus kyi lo rgyus sogs grub thob rnams kyi rnam thar dpag tu med pa mchis tshe/ don du ni dbang zhus ma zhus gcig pu la tshad mi bzung bar smin nus ma nus la gtso bor bya/ ༈ de nas grol byed kyi gdams pa dngos la'ang zhus lo dang thob lo'i rnam grangs tsam gyis ni rang rgyud grol ba lta zhog

/nyon mongs cung zad kha bri ba'am bdag 'dzin dang zhen chags cung zhig chung ngu 'gro ba tsam yang shin tu dka' bar mngon sum gyis grub phyir/ des na chos gang la nyams len byed pa de nyid kyi lam rtags rnams tshul bzhin shar thub pa'am/ tha na yang tshig don la nges pa rnyed pa'i thabs la nan tan du bya ba ni spyir gces pa dang*/ khyad par du ni/ gdams pa'i bye brag mtha' yas mod kyang*/ mdor bsdu na sgrub pa po rang nyid zab lam chos drug gam/ lam 'bras pa lta bu zhig yin pa'i dbang du bgyi na/ gtum mo lam gyi gzhung shing la nyams len brtson 'grus drag pos 'bad nas/ gnas pa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlung*/ bkod pa byang chub sems kyi rtsal sbyong la brten pas zag med lhan skyes ye shes bde stong zung 'jug mchog gi lam la gnad du bsnun te/ kun rdzob 'byung 'dus kyi phung po dwangs ma 'ja' lus kyi rang bzhin du smin cing*/ don dam shes rig gi ngo bo chos sku skye med kyi dbyings su ro gcig pa'i sku gnyis zung 'jug gi go 'phang tshe 'di kho nar 'grub pa'i thabs la rab tu brtson pas mthar phyin par bya ba dang*/ gang zag de rdzogs chen pa lta bu yin na/ spyir rdzogs chen la phyi sems sde/ nang klong sde/ gsang ba man ngag /yang gsang bla na med pa dang*/ a ti spyi ti yang ti sogs rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ bsdu na khregs chod rig stong gi nyams len dang*/ thod rgal snang stong gi nyams len gnyis su gnad thams cad 'dus pas de nyid bka' gter gang dang gang gi lugs la zhugs kyang*/ dang por bla ma mchog la mthar phyin pa zhus te/ mi med kyi lung stongs su lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba dgu phrugs su btang zhing*/ 'khor 'das ru shan phyes te nyin mtshan kha sbyor du bya byed gzhan dang skad cig kyang ma 'dres par nyams su blangs na/ lus thog 'dir kun bzang chos sku'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur zhing*/

'di la gang zag dbang po rab 'bring gsum tshan dgur phyes pa'i rab kyi rab sbrul mdud nam mkhar grol ba'i dpe ltar/ gdams pa thob pa dang grol ba dus mnyam rig 'dzin chen po dga' rab rdo rje lta bu/ rab kyi 'bring mtsho la kha ba babs pa ltar gang shar chos nyid du thim nas grol ba 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ shrī singha/ bi ma la/ pad 'byung la sogs 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa rnams dang*/ rab kyi mtha' ma 'khyag rum chur zhu ba bzhin/ gdams pa nyams len yun du 'bad pas 'khrul pa'i bag chags dang*/ gdos bcas kyi phung po 'od lus su rim gyis grol ba/ myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po/ lce btsun seṅge dbang phyug /slob dpon nyang ston sku mched la sogs lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod grub pa rnams lta bu ste/ mdor na phyag rdzogs lam sbyor zhi gcod la sogs gdams pa zab mos tshe 'di nyid la grub pa mthar phyin pa rnams la ni/ bar do 'og ma rnams mthong mi dgos par lus thog 'dir grol ba ni/ skye gnas bar do'i nyams len mthar phyin pa'i tshad yin kyang*/ deng sang ni bka' gsar rnying su la bltas rung de lta bu shin tu dkon par mchi'o// 'on kyang rnam g.yeng snyom las kyi dbang du ma song bar nyams len gyi dngos gzhi phyag rdzogs gang yin la gcig sgril du bya ba dang*/ mtshan mo'i nyams len du rmi lam dang 'od gsal/ thun mtshams thams cad du sgyu lus dang bar do/ thun gyi mgo mjug rnams su bla ma yi dam gyi bskyed bzlas gsol 'debs bsngo smon sogs te/ mdor na spyir gyi sgo gsum tha mal 'khrul 'byams su ma shor ba dang*/ sgos su bar do 'og ma rnams kyi nyams len thams cad la da lta nas goms 'dris yid 'jags nan tan du bya dgos pa ni bka' gsar rnying thams cad kyi dgongs bzhed gcig tu mthun pa'i gnad 'gag gal po che lags so// 'dir smras pa/ yid bzhin nor 'dra'i dal 'byor legs thob cing*// dge ba'i bshes dang zab chos rnyed gyur kyang*// 'khor ba nyams dga'i ltad mo la yengs te// gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub pa nyin skar tsam// tho yor lus dang sems kyi byi'u chung gnyis// yud tsam tshogs 'dir byang chub mi bsgrub na// thos thos shes shes rnam grangs brgya yod kyang*// 'khor ba'i mtsho chen sgrol la mi phan no// phun tshogs rang dbang yod dus le lor bsdad// bzlog med 'chi bdag byung tshe 'gyod pas gzir// rang phung rang sgrub smyon pa dug 'thung 'dra// tshul 'di skye gnas bar do'i snang tshul lags// ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/

༈ /spyi don gnyis pa/ 'chi kha sdug bsngal gyi bar do'i rang bzhin bshad pa la'ang*/ gsum gyi dang po ngo bo ngos bzung ba ni/ 'chi rkyen gang yin pa de'i nad kyis zin pa nas bar do dang po chos nyid don gyi 'od gsal ma shar tshun chad kyi skabs rnams yin la/ 'di skabs su chos spyi las 'od gsal shar ba de yang*/ bar do 'di nyid kyi khongs su tshur bsdus nas ston mod kyang*/ da res 'dir ni rdzogs chen rnams nas gsungs pa ltar/ chos nyid 'od gsal gyi bar do ni 'og tu 'chad phyir/ 'dir 'chi kha bar do kho na bstan par bya'o/ ༈ /gzhan yang gong du brjod pa ltar/ gang zag mchog rab kyi rigs can lus thog 'dir grol ba dag la ni bar do 'og ma 'di rnams mi 'byung ste/ de yang rdzogs chen rnams nas 'di ltar gsungs te/ rnal 'byor pa rab rnams la 'chi lugs bzhi yod/ bum chag nam mkha' phyi nang 'dres pa bzhin lus sems chos sku stong nyid du thim pa dang*/ de bzhin du bud shing zad pas me dpung dul ba ltar dang*/ nam mkha' 'od phung gis gang ba rig 'dzin 'chi ba lta bu dang*/ shi yang phung po 'dor rgyu med pa mkha' 'gro ma 'chi ba lta bu rnams ni rab kyi 'chi lugs so// zhes pa 'di dag la ni thim rim gyi spros pa dang bral la/ yang rnal 'byor pa 'bring la 'chi lugs gsum ste/ 'chi ba'i dus dang*/ 'chi mi 'chi'i rtsis gdab med pa bu chung 'chi ba lta bu dang*/ yul rkyen la nyam nga med pa phyogs med sprang po 'chi ba lta bu dang*/ yul rkyen gyi 'khri ba bcad de gangs khrod lung stongs sogs su 'chi ba seṅge lta bu rnams ni 'bring gi 'chi lugs so// zhes pa 'di dag la yang gsal 'debs sogs la mi ltos par rtogs pa'i gdengs dang ldan pa'i 'chi lugs yin la/ rnal 'byor pa tha ma dang gang zag phal pa spyi'i 'chi lugs kyi 'char tshul rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ phyi 'byung ba'i khams dbang skye mched thim tshul dang*/

nang rnam rtog phra rags kyi thim tshul gnyis bshad cing*/ zhar la 'pho ba'i man ngag gi skabs don bshad pa dang bcas pa'o/ ༈ /de la dang po ni/ spyir skye 'gro thams cad dang por lus chags pa yang 'byung ba lnga la brten nas chags/ bar du yang de dag la brten nas gnas/ mthar 'jig pa yang de dag thim sdud kyis 'jig par 'gyur ba yin te/ de yang 'chi dus las rlung gyen la log nas rlung thams cad des dbang byas shing 'khor lo lnga'i rtsa mdud zhig pa dang*/ rlung lnga mal 'chugs pas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi 'byung ba so sor thim pa yin te/ 'di dag gi thim tshul rgyas par rdzogs chen rig pa rang shar gyi rgyud las 'byung yang*/ 'dir yig tshogs la 'dzem nas ma bshad la/ gsar rnying spyi mthun ltar gyi 'gag bsdus te brjod na/ de yang dang por mnyam gnas kyi rlung mal 'chugs pa'i dbang gis kha zas mi 'ju zhing drod mtha' nas sdud/ srog 'dzin 'chugs pas shes pa mi gsal zhing 'chugs pa dang*/ thur sel 'chugs pas bshang gci mi thub pa dang*/ gyen rgyu 'chugs pas zas skom nang du mid mi shes shing dbugs sna thung*/ khyab byed 'chugs pas yan lag las su mi rung zhing*/ rtsa rnams sdud par 'gyur ba dang*/ rtsa 'khor rnams 'jig pa'i thog mar lte ba'i rtsa 'khor 'jig par bshad cing*/ de nas rim pa ltar 'dogs byed kyi rlung 'bros pas sa khams chu la thim pas phyi'i rtags su/ lus kyi stobs shor te mjing pas mgo mi theg /rkang pas lus mi theg /lag pas zas snod mi theg /byad la ham pa dang*/ so la dreg nag chags shing kha chu sna chu mi thub par 'gyur ba dang*/ phyi rtags de rnams byung tshe nang gi rtags su shes pa rab tu bying zhing 'thib pa'i dbang gis shin tu zub pa'i snang ba shar nas lag pa phyir 'don cing gos bsal ba dang*/ nga slong dang zer zhing mig mthongs khar lta bar byed pa dang*/ 'di dus gsang ba'i rtags su 'od gsal smig rgyu lta bu rab rib tu 'char ba'i dus yin/

de nas snying ga'i rtsa 'khor 'jig cing bkrag mdangs bskyed pa'i rlung 'bros pas chu khams me la thim rtags su/ kha lce skam zhing sna zhom/ lce rtse rang gis mi mthong zhing 'khyog /nang rtags su shes pa bun cing 'tshubs nas tshig pa za ba dang*/ gsang rtags su du ba lta bu lang long gi snang ba 'byung*/ de nas mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor 'jig cing dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i rlung 'bros pas me khams rlung la thim pa'i rtags su/ kha sna'i dbugs grangs sil gyis 'gro zhing lus nang gi drod phyir 'chor bas rlangs pa thol gyis byung ste drod mtha' nas chad/ nang rtags shes pa res gsal res mi gsal bas ngo shes la mi shes tsam dang*/ phyi rol gyi snang ba 'di gsal por mi mthong*/ gsang rtags srin bu me khyer ltar dmar khyem khyem pa 'char/ de nas gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor 'jig cing bskal pa las kyi rlung 'bros te rlung khams rnam shes la thim pas/ phyi rtags su dbugs brtsegs mar 'byung zhing phyir rgyu ba ring la nang du sdud dka' ba dang*/ sgra ngar ngar po 'byin zhing mig gyen la log /nang rtags su shes pa 'khrul nas mthong snang sna tshogs 'char te/ sdig can rnams la gshin rje'i snang ba mthong bas skrag ste/ lus sprad sprad dang rnam 'gyur sna tshogs byed cing 'jigs pa'i sgra skad 'don/ las bzang po rnams la ni dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu ma dang dge ba'i snang ba 'char bar bshad/ gsang rtags su sgron me 'bar ba lta bu'i snang ba 'char te/ de ltar 'byung ba lnga dang rlung chen lnga thim pas de'i tshe yan lag gi rlung lnga rang gzhar la mal 'chugs pas dbang po skye mched rnams kyang rim gyis thim pa ste/ mig /rna ba/ sna lce/ lus kyi dbang po rnams nus pa nyams shing thim pa'i gnad kyis gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams mi tshor ba dag kyang log par tshor zhing bzang ngan gyi dbye ba spu ris mi phyed par 'gyur/ de nas rnam shes nam mkha' la thim pa zhes bya ste phyi dbugs chad par 'gyur la/

'di dus lus kyi mdog snum zhing 'jam pa/ snying kha yan chad du drod cung zad yod la/ bar do 'phrang sgrol sogs las ni 'di yan la thun mong gi 'chi rtags zhes bya ba yin pas/ nad gdon gyi byed pas 'ga' zhig mtshams 'di nas tshur ldog pa yang 'byung bar gsungs so// de nas khyad par gyi 'chi rtags cis kyang ldog mi srid pa'i snang rtog phra rags kyi thim rim rnams yin te/ de yang dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ lus can rnams ni 'chi ba na// zla ba bdud rtsi thur du 'gro// steng du nyi rdul sgra gcan dang*// rnam shes srid pa'i mtshan nyid do// zhes pa ltar/ snang mched thob gsum thim zhing dug gsum las gyur pa'i rtog pa'i rang bzhin brgyad cu 'gags pas/ dkar lam sogs shar ba ste/ 'di skabs su dkar lam dmar lam gnyis po sngon la 'char tshul nges med du bshad kyang*/ 'dir dus 'khor ltar 'chad par bya ste/ de yang lus can rnams kyi dbu ma'i yar sne ste/ spyi bor pha las thob pa'i khams kun rdzob rgyu'i thig le dkar po haṃ yig gi tshul du gnas pa ste/ steng rlung 'chugs pa'i gnad kyis dbu ma'i lam nas thur du byung tshe rang snang du zla ba shar ba lta bu dkar lam gyi snang ba dang dus mtshungs par zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog tshogs kyi bye brag sum cu rtsa gsum yang 'gag par 'gyur ba ste/ de rnams gang zhe na/ 1 chags bral 2 bar ma 3 chen po dang*// 4 yid kyi 'gro dang 5 'ong ba dang*// 6 mya ngan chung 7 'bring 8 chen po dang*// 9 zhi dang 10 rnam par rtog pa dang*// 11 'jigs dang 12 bar 'jigs 13 shin tu 'jigs// 14 sred dang 15 bar sred 16 shin tu sred// 17 nyer len 18 mi dge 19 bkres dang 20 skom// 21 tshor dang 22 tshor 'bring 23 shin tu tshor// 24 rig dang 25 rig po 'dzin pa'i gzhi// 26 so sor rtog dang 27 ngo tsha shes// 28 snying rje 29 brtse ba chung 30 'bring 31 che// 32 dgos bcas sdud dang

33 phrag dog ste// rnam rtog sum cu rtsa gsum yin// ces pa rnams 'gag par 'gyur ba'o// de nas dbu ma'i mar sna ste lte bar ma las thob pa'i khams dmar cha'i dwangs ma a shad kyi rnam par gnas pa de nyid 'og rlung 'chugs pa'i mthus dgyen du song ba'i dus su snang ba dmar lam pa zhig 'char ba dang lhan cig /'dod chags kyi rtog pa bzhi bcu rnams kyang 'gag ste/ gang zhe na/ 1 chags pa dang ni 2 zhen pa dang*// 3 dga' dang 4 bar dga' 5 shin tu dga'// 6 rang sa dang ni 7 rab mgu dang*// 8 ngo mtshar 9 tshim dang 10 rgod dang 11 'khyud// 12 'o byed 13 'jibs dang 14 brten pa dang*// 15 brtson dang 16 khengs dang 17 bya ba dang*// 18 'grogs dang 19 stobs dang 20 spro ba dang*// 21 dga' la sbyor ba chung 22 'bring 23 che// 24 dregs dang 25 rnam par sgeg pa dang*// 26 'bras dang 27 dge dang 28 tshig gsal dang*// 29 bden dang 30 bden min 31 nges pa dang*// 32 nyer len sbyin dang 34 bskul dang 35 dpa'// 36 ngo tsha med dang 37 zin dang 38 gdug /39 mi bsrun dang ni 40 gya gyu'o// zhes pa rnams 'gag pa'o/ ༈ /de nas khyab byed kyi rlung gis rig pa bskyod pa de nyid byang sems dkar dmar 'phrad pa'i bar du 'thums mtshams der snang ba nag lam pa gcig 'char zhing*/ gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun kyang 'gag ste/ gang zhe na/ 1 chags pa bar ma'i skad cig dang*// 2 brjed ngas 3 'khrul dang 4 mi smrar 'gyur// 5 skyo dang 6 le lo 7 the tshom bdun// zhes pa thams cad 'gags shing 'ga' zhig la gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal drag po myong bar bshad la/ gzhan ni thim pa rnams rdzogs pa'i skabs 'dir rtsa rlung khams sems kun gyi dwangs ma snying gar lhan cig 'dzoms pa la brten nas/ nam mkha' 'od gsal la thim pa zhes kyang bya ste/ bar do dang po'i gzhi'i 'od gsal nyid 'jag ma'i srin bu yan chad la 'char ba'o/ ༈ /da ni bar do 'di dag lam du khyer tshul ston te/

de yang spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'i tshul dang*/ sgos su rang nyid nam 'chi cha med pa dang*/ khyad par 'chi dus su bla ma'i gdams ngag ma gtogs gang gis kyang mi phan pa'i tshul rnams rtag tu yid la ma bsams na/ chos kyi sna kha mang po la rtog 'jug gam/ skyid 'dod lto gos kyi rtsol sgrub sogs byed pa'i bar la 'chi bas slebs te 'gyod dgos pa 'byung ba nyid/ ched du brjod pa'i tshom las/ bu dang nor phyug 'byor ba la// mi rnams yod ni rnam chags nas// 'di ni byas zin da 'di bya// de dag byas nas 'di bya zhes// mi rnams g.yeng bas bslus kyi bar// 'chi bdag gis ni blang nas 'gro// zhes sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung mgur sogs las rgya cher 'byung ba bzhin/ chos snying por dril ba zhig ma byas na rnam rig dang thos bsam sogs kyis dgos dus bslus pa mang zhing*/ khyad par tshe'i dus la nam babs pa'i skabs der yang*/ lugs gnyis bya byed spros bcas rnams kyi 'phro'am lhag ma sogs lus pa'i sems khral lta bu dang*/ gnyen 'dun mdza' grogs mtho dman gang dang gang la'ang chags pa dang sdang ba'i yid byed thams cad rtsa ba nas lings kyis dor/ zang zing yo byad kyi rigs kyang che ba sku gsung thugs rten nas chung ba khab skud yan chad thams cad ltos med mchod sbyin spong dag byas la/ sems kyi lhag ma spu tsam yang lus rgyu dang zhen yul med par byed pa ni gal chen gyi gnad du snang bas blo thag chod par bya/ 'chi kha'i bsam pa stobs dbang btsan pas sdom pa dam tshig sogs la nyes ltung phra zhing phra ba'i rigs/ tshor ba dang ma tshor ba mtha' dag dngos sam yid kyis bshags sdom bya ba dang*/ dngos su bla ma 'dzoms na'ang skyabs yul dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsal la ting 'dzin dbang dang sdom pa blangs/ grogs kyang dam gtsang chos mthun gdams ngag gi gsal 'debs sogs shes pa yod na shin tu legs la/

gzhan ni 'jig rten gyi gnyen 'dun sogs ngu skad dang mya ngan gyi chags sdang bskyed par 'gyur ba'i rkyen rnams/ tho phyir gtan nas med pa gal che che/ rab kyis ni sngar bshad pa bzhin ri dwags lta bu'i 'chi lugs sogs kho na legs par gsungs phyir grogs kyi spros pa bcad/ de nas thim rim rnams kyang 'dir bshad pa rnams gang zag spyi khyab la 'byung tshul brda mtshon tsam ste/ gzhan ni so so'i rtsa rlung khams rigs tha dad kyi khyad par dang*/ nad gdon rkyen dbang sogs nges med du 'byung bas thim rim snga rting sna tshogs dang*/ 'ga' zhig la ni cig car rtsal sprugs su bsdu ba yang 'byung bas 'di bzhin tshad can du ni mi 'byung la/ gang ltar yang phyi nang gsang ba'i rtags snang tshul rnams snga gong nas blo la 'jags shing 'dris pa gal che/ de nas dus la nam babs pa'i tshe lus gnad ni rab kyi tsog pu'am/ mi nus na gzhog g.yas phab ste seṅge'i nyal lugs su bya zhing*/ nyams len goms 'dris gang la yod pa de nyid la dril dgos phyir/ phyag rgya chen po'am/ rdzogs chen khregs chod pa'am/ zhi byed pa sogs mdor na stong gsal rang rig gi dran pa la gtso bor byed pa zhig yin na/ thim rim gang shar thams cad gnas lugs chos nyid kyi ngang kho nar glod pa las/ gzhan du ma yengs ma 'khrul tsam nyid la chig dril du byas na/ gzhi'i 'od gsal la ma slebs kyi bar gzhan bya mi dgos la/ der slebs nas ni grol ba la tshegs med do// yang sbyor drug pa'am/ rdzogs chen thod rgal snang mun gnyis kyi 'od gsal la goms pa zhig yin na/ 'byung bzhi thim tshe gsang rtags du ba smig rgyu sogs rim can du shar ba mtha' dag rang rig chos sku'i gsal mdangs kho nar thag chod pa'i nges pa dang*/ gsal stong ye shes lhun grub kyi nyams len la rtse gcig tu 'bad/ yang lam 'bras sam chos drug sogs zab lam bde stong phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa la 'dris pa'i tshe na'ang de dang mthun par rtsa 'khor so so'i rlung sems sdud rim ngo shes par bya zhing*/

khyad par du yang dkar lam 'char ba'i tshe snang ba'i 'od gsal du shes pas dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i lam khyer dga' ba'i ye shes kyi don mngon du bya ba dang*/ de bzhin du dmar lam shar tshe mched pa'i nyams dang las kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes dran pa dang*/ nag lam 'char dus thob pa'i nyams chos kyi phyag rgya'i don dga' bral lam khyad dga'i ye shes la mnyam par 'jog pa dang*/ gnad gcod kyi zug rngu gang byung nyams len dang bsres la/ lhan skyes ma shar gyi bar du mtshams sbyor ngan pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bya'o// gzhan yang gang zag de lta bu'i nyams rtogs dang mi ldan pa zhig yin pa'i tshe na'ang*/ byin rlabs bla ma'i mos gus la gnad du bsnun te/ de yang dang po sa khams thim zhing 'od gsal smig rgyu snang dus su snying gar bla ma bsgom zhing mos gus rtse gcig byas la/ yid kyis gsol ba gdab/ chu khams thim nas du ba lta bu 'char tshe lte 'khor du bla ma bsgom/ me khams thim zhing me khyer lta bu snang tshe dpral bar bla ma bsgom/ rlung khams thim ste sgron me lta bu dag la ni khyad par dran mchog bla ma'i 'pho ba la gnad du bsnun par gsungs so/ ༈ /da ni zhar la 'pho ba'i skabs don bshad pa la gsum ste/ gang zag gi khyad par dang*/ 'pho ba'i dus dang*/ 'pho ba dngos dang gsum las/ gang zag ni/ rnal 'byor rab tshe 'dir phyag rdzogs sogs kyi don mngon du gyur te lhag med du 'grub pa'am/ ma 'grub kyang dbugs chad pa dang grol ba dus mnyam gyi gding ldan dag la ni 'pho ba'i man ngag logs su sbyang yang mi dgos la/ 'pho ba 'debs su yong mi 'tshal zhing*/ 'on kyang gdul bya gzhan drang ba'i don la dgongs nas 'pho ba'i tshul mdzad pa ltar snang ba ni/ rgya gar na slob dpon klu sgrub sogs mang po dang*/ bod du yang rje mar pa mya ngan las 'da' khar yum bdag med ma 'od kyi gong bur byas nas thugs kar bsdus te/

sku lus bsrangs nas bu kun 'pho ba byed na 'di ltar gyis shig gsungs te dbu thod kyi tshal pa yal ba'i shul nas 'od lnga ldan sgo nga tsam zhig steng gi nam mkhar 'phags pa'i snang tshul bstan pa dang*/ grub thob me long rdo rjes tshogs 'khor gyi dbus su zhal chems kyi mgur gsungs pa'i mthar/ dbu gtsug nas 'od zer dkar po rdza ma tsam zhig nam mkhar 'phags pa je cher gyur pas 'ja' 'od dang thig les nam mkha' khyab par mdzad pa sogs mdor na gsar rnying gi grub thob skyes chen mang pos 'di ltar mdzad tshul shin tu mang mod kyi/ 'di dag ni ming 'pho ba ru btags kyang don la 'ja' lus dang khyad cher mi 'byung zhing*/ yang 'ga' zhig rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa'i rigs can 'ga' zhig la ni 'pho ba btab kyang mi thebs par bshad/ ci'i phyir na 'pho ba'i gdams ngag de byin rlabs la rag cing*/ de ni bla ma la rag lus pas dam tshig rtsa ba nas nyams shing ma bshags na byin rlabs 'jug pa'i yul med phyir 'pho ba yang 'bras bu med do// 'o na rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud las/ mtshams med lnga po byed pa yang*// 'di yi lam gyis grol gyur te// sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so snyam na/ de ni dang por sdig pa la spyad kyang slar nyams len la zhugs pas grol ba rnams dang*/ der ma zad rdo rje slob dpon la dam tshig ma nyams shing dad pa dang ldan na sdig can yang 'pho bas grol ba la dgongs pa'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa 'pho ba'i dus ni phyi 'byung rags pa thim pa yan chad ni tshur sos pa'ang srid la/ gang zag gzhan la 'pho ba 'debs sngas na des khong khro sogs mtshams sbyor ngan pa byed rkyen gyi nyen yang yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang rgyud las/ dus la babs na 'pho bya ste// dus min lha rnams bsad par 'gyur// ces gsungs phyir dus gnad gal che la/ dus ni sngar bshad pa ltar gyi 'byung ba rnams thim zhing phyi dbugs chad nas nang gi snang ba thim rtags dkar lam shar ba dang 'pho ba gsal gdab la/

mched pa thim rtags dmar lam shar mtshams su sdig can la gshin rje'i 'jigs snang dang*/ las dag pa rnams la dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bsu ba'i bkod pa 'char bas de dus 'pho bar bya'o/ ༈ /'pho ba'i gdams pa dngos ni/ sbyangs pa dang las sbyor gnyis las/ dang po sbyangs pa gal che ba dang*/ ji ltar sbyong ba'i thabs kyi rnam grangs mang yang bsdu na lngar 'dus te/ chos sku gtad med kyi 'pho ba/ longs sku zung 'jug gi 'pho ba/ sprul sku rtsal sbyong gi 'pho ba/ byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba/ 'chugs med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba dang lngar gsungs pa las/ dang po chos sku'i don ni/ sngar bshad pa'i phyag rdzogs sogs la brtan pa thob pa nyid yin tshe logs su sbyang mi 'tshal zhing*/ 'di skabs rdzogs chen snying thig dag la ni/ shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma zhes bya ba rang rig 'di nyid/ lam dkar 'jam rtsa'i sgron ma nas brgyud/ sgo rgyang zhag chu'i sgron ma las thon te/ yul dbyings rnam dag gi sgron mar 'pho tshul gyi brdar thabs rgyas par gsungs phyir/ chos de dag gi nyams len la goms pas ni de ltar bya zhing*/ zab lam chos drug la ni gshis lugs gnyug ma'i 'pho ba zhes gsungs pa yang*/ chos sku'i 'pho ba 'di nyid do/ ༈ /gnyis pa longs sku zung 'jug ni/ gang zag bskyed rim tshul ldan la rang dbang thob pa'am/ chos drug ltar na dag pa'i sgyu lus la bsgom pa mngon gyur dag gi spyod yul te/ mdor na chos sku longs sku gnyis po 'di ni tshe 'dir rdzogs rim dang bskyed rim la rab tu goms pas/ dus la nam babs tshegs med 'grub pa las/ phal pa gzhan gyis ni ma yin cing*/ don dam gsang chen gyi 'pho ba'ang 'dir 'du ba'o/ ༈ /gsum pa sprul sku rtsal sbyong gi 'pho ba'am/ gsal snang mig 'phrul gyi 'pho ba 'di la ni da lta nas sbyong ba gal che ste khrid rim gang gi rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar ram 'pho ba'i sgos khrid byed kyang rung ste/

bla ma nyams myong byin rlabs dang ldan pa la zhus nas rtags thon du sbyang bar bya ste/ de la skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ dngos gzhi ni/ bca' ba lus kyi gnad/ 'pho 'jug rlung gi gnad/ 'phrul bsgyur dmigs pa'i gnad rnams la rtse gcig tu bya zhing lus yi dam gang rung gi bskyed rim dang ldan pa'i ngang nas 'khor ba'i sgo brgyad dgag pa dang*/ gsal stong lus kyi stong pa'i nang du dbu ma rtsa'i stong ra gsal ba dang*/ tshangs bug skar khung gi steng na 'od dpag med dam lhag pa'i lha gang mos bsgom pa dang*/ rlung sems kyi ngo bo lha sku'i yig 'bru phyag mtshan 'od gong la sogs dbu ma'i lam du 'grim 'grul spar 'bebs kyi rtsal sbyang ba rnams dang*/ thun mthar tshe bsring gi man ngag sogs mdor na 'pho ba'i gzhung gang byed de ka'i lugs dang mthun par sbyangs/ gal te log non dang kha bsgyur sogs dgos pa byung na'ang bla mas legs par bstan la rtags thon par bya'o/ ༈ /bzhi pa byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba yang*/ spyi bo'i lha de bla mar bsgom pa ma gtogs gzhan phal cher 'di dang mthun zhing*/ 'di la ni khyad par du bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su shes pa'i mos gus gal che'o/ ༈ /lnga pa mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba ni/ dag pa'i zhing khams sbyong ba ste/ 'di la ni gang zag de rmi lam sprul bsgyur 'byong pa zhig dgos la/ rdzogs chen du rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing du dbugs dbyung ba'i gdams pa gsungs pa rnams dang don gcig go/ ༈ /mthar 'pho ba las la sbyar ba ni/ de ltar 'pho ba'i rigs rnams gang byed kyang tshe 'di snang gi zhen chags dang*/ dug gsum sogs nyon mongs pa'i dbang du ma shor bar dmigs pa gar gtad la yid ches rtse gcig las su rung ba gcig dgos te/ mtshams sbyor ngan pa cung zad tsam gyis kyang 'pho ba'i gegs byed pas na/ ngan rtog gi dbang du skad cig kyang mi btang bar dus la nam babs tshe dpag chen gyi mda' ltar dmigs pa'i 'ben la the tshom med par 'phangs te phyir mi dbab bo// des ni gru kha skya ba'am/

rta kha srab kyis bsgyur ba bzhin gang 'dod kyi don 'grub ste/ lar 'pho ba 'pho ba zer yang rang gi rig pa dri med 'di ngos bzung nas 'khrul pa'i lam du kha shor du mi 'jug par gdams ngag gi srang la bcur nas chos kyi dbyings su bstim pa la zer bas/ tshe rabs nas smon lam dang tshogs gnyis kyi bsags rgyab cung yod pa rnams dang*/ tshe 'dir yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos dang bla ma la mos pa ma log cing dam tshig la nyes ltung med pa zhig gis ni 'grub sla bar gda' yang*/ su rung rung gis yong bar dka' ba 'dra zhing*/ sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgyas zer ba yang gong du bshad pa ltar gyi rten 'brel 'dzom dgos par gsal bas/ gdams ngag thams cad kyi goms 'dris dang rten 'brel kun da lta rang dbang dang long khyab yod dus nas bsgrigs pa ni gnad dam pa'o// 'dir smras pa/ rje rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs rje las// chos mdo rgyud zab don gyi char babs kyang*// blo 'khrul zhen a 'thas kyi sems can la// rgyud smin grol myu gu zhig 'khrungs par dka'// tshe 'di gang chos min gyi dbang btang nas// don dgos nges dam chos nyid yal bar dor// nam 'chi khar 'gyod chen gyi me long de// rang gdong la rang nyid kyis 'char tshe 'phyis// dran gsal po mi chos kyi pher yong dang*// tshig kha bshad rgya 'byams kyi mkhas pa rnams// gag thug po shi nad kyis thebs dus der// gyong len nyen su zhig la 'ded dam sems// ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ ༈ /don gsum pa chos nyid 'od gsal gyi bar do'i rang bzhin bshad pa la yang*/ ngo bo ngos bzung ba dang*/ 'char tshul rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ gdams ngag lam du khyer thabs dang gsum gyi dang po/ ngo bo gang zhe na/ de ltar gong du bshad pa'i thim rim mtha' dag rdzogs pa dang*/ khams kyi dwangs ma dkar dmar a haṃ thabs shes kha sbyor gyi bar du rlung rig 'dus pa'i rkyen gyis ye gdod ma'i 'od gsal chos kyi sku spros bral lhan cig skyes pa bde ba chen po'i ye shes bcos ma ma yin pa zhig nges par 'char ba de la ming gi rnam grangs su rgyu'i theg pa rnams las ni/

don dam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya la/ dbu ma pas ni don dam pa'i bden pa zhes zer/ phyag chen pas ni mi rtog pa nang 'phrod pa yang zer/ rdzogs chen sems phyogs pa rnams ni rig pa gshis thog tu phebs pa zer/ 'od gsal gsang skor ba rnams las ni lhun grub 'od kyi bsun ma yang zer/ zab lam pa rnams lhan skyes ye shes kyi phyag rgya chen po yang zer/ chos spyi khyab kun mthun par bar do dang po'i 'od gsal zhes grags pa de nyid do// 'char tshul rgyas par bshad pa la yang*/ thun mong dang khyad par gnyis kyi dang po ni/ de yang rgyud sde phal mo che rnams las ni/ thog mar smig rgyu la sogs sngar bshad pa rnams rim can du 'char ba de la snang ba'i 'od gsal du brjod la/ thim rim rdzogs nas gzhi'i 'od gsal dngos de la snang med kyi'am/ stong pa'i 'od gsal kyang zer/ yang 'ga' zhig las ni/ snang mched thob gsum gyi shar tshul de dag la rtags kyi 'od gsal dang*/ dngos gzhi 'di la don gyi 'od gsal zhes pa'i tha snyad kyang mdzad cing*/ gnyis med rnam rgyal las kyang*/ dang po smig rgyu de nyid kyang*// 'od zer lnga dang ldan par mthong*// gnyis pa zla ba lta bu dang*// gsum pa nyi ma lta bu ste// bzhi pa mun pa lta bu dang*// zhes rtags kyi 'od gsal dang*/ lnga pa sprin med nam mkha' ltar// mi rtog mtha' dbus med par 'char// zhes don gyi 'od gsal dngos bstan pa'o// de dag la rtags kyi 'od gsal du brjod pa ci zhe na/ dang po smig rgyu sogs ni sgo lnga'i rnam shes kun gzhir thim pa'i rtags dang*/ de bzhin du/ dkar lam nyon yid kun gzhir thim rtags dang*/ dmar lam ni ye shes thim rtags dang*/ nag lam ni kun gzhi ma rig pa'i cha de nyid rang sar thim pa dang*/ de thams cad don dam chos dbyings su thim pa chos sku'i ye shes dri ma dang bral ba 'char ba yin la/ de ltar gzhi'i 'od gsal de nyid skabs 'dir 'char ba'i rgyu ni/

sems can thams cad la bde gshegs snying pos ye khyab tu gnas pa de nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa'am/ kun gzhi gti mug gi chas bsgribs te/ rang la yod pa'i ye shes yin par rang ngo ma shes pas rtag tu 'khrul 'byams su gyur cing*/ thim rim gyi skabs 'dir sgrib cha de dar gcig rang sar thim pa'i gnad kyis ye shes rjen par shar ba yin la/ tha mal pa rnams la shar yang rang ngo ma shes pas slar bsgribs pa'i bag chags langs te yang yang skye ba phyi ma'i 'phro mthud nas 'khor ba lu gu rgyud du gyur pa yin pa dang*/ gdams pa'i gnad la goms pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor rnams la ni gdod ma'i gnas lugs rang bzhin gyis shar ba'i 'od gsal ma de dang*/ lam nyams su blangs pa'i 'od gsal bu de nyid sngar 'dris kyi mi 'phrad pa'am/ chu sna rgya mtshor slebs pa ltar dbyer med du 'dres phyir grol sla ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin pa ste/ 'di la gsang sngags gsar ma ltar na/ don dam pa'i 'og min chos kyi dbyings rnam dag gi pho brang na/ zung 'jug yan lag bdun ldan gyi ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen dbyings dang ye shes ro mnyam du gyur pa'i bdag nyid ces sogs gsungs pa dang*/ rnying lugs rnams nas kyang gdal ba chen po kun khyab kyi zhing du yid byed pa po kun tu bzang po rang shes rig pa'i rgyal po dang*/ chos bya ba mo kun tu bzang mo mkha' dbyings rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid gnyis/ dbyer med bde chen ka dag gi ngo bor dus bzhi mnyam nyid 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs so// zhes sogs mdor na gsang sngags zab mo'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi thams cad gnas lugs 'di'i mngon rtogs su gsungs pa kho na nyid las ma 'das pa yin na'ang blo chung dang rtog ge pa rnams kyi blor shong ba dka' mod/ khyad par skabs 'dir nyid kyis dris pa'i dngos don snying po dang*/ 'phros su rdo rje'i tshig rkang skyes chen rnams kyi gsung bgros lung 'dren dang bcas mdzad snang ba de bzhin bdag gi yid la yang shin tu babs shing*/

'di skabs ni gsar rnying gi rgyud sde rnams dang*/ rig 'dzin grub thob thams cad bzhed pa'ang zhal mthun par/ gzhi'i 'od gsal 'di don dam chos sku'i ngo bo'i grol gzhir dgos tshul mthun la/ 'on kyang rje jo nang pa'i zhal chems su/ bla ma gzhan rnams 'od gsal zhes 'dod pa de ni gzhi gnas la brtan pa cung zad thob pa'i gang zag la rlung dbu mar chud pas bde snang cung zhig 'char ba la sems chags pa yin zhing*/ brag phug 'od gsal ces bya ste 'od gsal rnal ma ru mi 'dod/ ces sogs gsungs pa yod par grags kyang*/ dgos pa gzhan la dgongs pa lta bu yin las che zhing*/ gzhan ni chos lugs thams cad 'di skabs bzhed tshul gcig par snang ba dang*/ lar gang zag phal che ba la ni shar yang ngo ma shes/ shes kyang goms pa chung tshe de'i ngang la gnas ma nus pas lan pa ma gtogs grol gzhi dngos yin min the tshom dang bral ba ste/ ji skad du/ rdzogs chen seṅge rtsal rdzogs kyi rgyud las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa'i chos nyid ni// 'gro ba kun la rang bzhin ye nas khyab// gsang ba'i rig pa yul la snang gyur na// snang ba'i 'od lnga ma bu 'phrad pa'i tshul// bu yi snang ba ma la thim pa'i tshe// bya byed blo yi snang ba kun sangs te// 'khrul rtog lung gi the tshom chod gyur nas// ye shes nyi zer kun tu snang ba yis// mtshan ma'i dngos po rab tu dengs par 'gyur// rnam rtog blo yi the tshom bral ba'i mthus// rig pa'i ye shes stobs su gyur nas ni// bsam bral ngang la de bzhin gnas pa 'byung*// snang ba med pa'i ye shes ci yang mthong*// gsang sngags 'bras bu bcud dang ldan gyur nas// rig pa'i ye shes thub pa med par snang*// de tshe rang gi dran pas sad nas ni// yul rkyen 'byung ba'i ngo bo rnam par dag /tha snyad bral ba'i ye shes don la spyod// gsang sngags tshad ma'i snang ba mthong bar 'gyur// yin dang min pa'i shes pa ma zhugs na// zhag lnga dag na ting 'dzin thob par 'gyur// ces sogs dang*/

nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rgyud las/ de phyir 'di ma gos pas chog /rang shar rang grol skye med klong*// lhun grub ka dag klong du thim// re dogs gnyis kyi mtha' dang bral// rgyu 'bras gnyis kyi mtha' zad nas// dbyings rig gnyis med ka dag grol// byar med lhun rdzogs chen po'o// zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang dus 'khor rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ 'od gsal de la sems zin na// bar do med par mya ngan dang*// sdug bsngal kun las nges par grol// ces dang*/ gnyis med rnam rgyal las kyang*/ 'od gsal zin pa'i gang zag la// bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// gzhan don gzugs sku'i snang ba 'char// dper na yid bzhin nor bu bzhin// ces sogs lung mtha' yas phyir the tshom mi bya'o// des spyi mthun ltar bshad nas/ khyad par rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag gi sde dang*/ yang gsang bla na med pa'i snying thig skor gyi lugs ltar na/ ka dag chos sku'i 'od gsal dang*/ longs sku'i 'od gsal gnyis su phye ba'i dang po de na/ sngar bstan pa'i gnas lugs gzhi'i 'od gsal sprin med kyi nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa lta bur 'char ba de nyid yin pas/ der rang ngo shes na shes thob der gdod ma'i ka dag chen por 'tshang rgya bas 'og ma rnams 'char ba'i spros pa dang bral la/ gal te de nyid la goms pa chung bas grol ma nus na de nas nang dbugs chad de dmar cha sna bug g.yas nas khrag gam chu ser gyi rnam pa phyir 'byung la dkar cha gsang lam nas 'thon pa dus mtshungs su/ rig pa me stag yal ba bzhin du mig sogs sgo gang rung nas 'thon pa dang*/ chos nyid bar do 'char ba yin la/ 'di la ka dag chos sku'i 'od gsal zer/ der ma grol na/ nam mkha' 'od gsal la thim pa'i mthar 'od gsal zung 'jug la thim pa zhes bya ba ni/ skad cig der khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha tshogs rgyan dang cha lugs phyag mtshan sna tshogs pa dang mgo brnyan gyi rnam pa mang po dang bcas pas 'jig rten gyi khams gang bar 'char/

chos nyid kyi rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba lta bu dang*/ 'od dang zer gyi tshogs mtshon cha'i char 'bab pa lta bu sogs 'jigs rung gi snang ba tshad med pa 'char bas/ 'di dus ngo ma 'phrod pa'i rigs rnams sems rab tu skrag cing brgyal bar 'gyur la/ brgyal sangs tsa na de dag gar song cha med du yal nas slar zhi ba'i lha tshogs rim gyis 'char te/ de yang snang yul mtha' dag gdos bcas sa rdo ri brag sogs med pa 'ja' 'od kyi rang bzhin kun tu gsal zhing 'tsher ba/ rgya che zhing thogs rdugs dang bral ba bkrag gsal lhun sdug cing mtha' las 'das pa'i rang bzhin can du snang ste/ de tshe rang gi lus kyi rnam pa ru yod pa snyam byed cing*/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og nam mkhas gar khyab tu 'ja' 'od lnga ldan gyi thig le'i rnam pa grangs med pa re re'i nang na rgyal ba rigs lnga sems dpa' sems ma sogs zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnam 'gyur cha lugs ngo mtshar lta bas chog mi shes pa dpag tu med par 'char ba de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od kyi zer thag shin tu phra ba re re rang gi snying gar zug par snang ba dang*/ snang ba de dag thams cad phrig phrig tu byed cing snying ga'i zer thag de las kyang thig le phra mo grangs med pa 'phro bar 'char la/ slar sku de dag thams cad rang nyid la thim par snang bar 'gyur zhing*/ de rjes zung 'jug ye shes la thim pa zhes bya ba/ rang gi snying ga nas steng gi nam mkhar 'od mthing ga dang*/ dkar po dang*/ ser po dang*/ dmar po rnams dar yug brkyangs pa lta bu brtsegs mar snang zhing*/ de dag la rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i 'od kyi thig le re re la yang thig phran lnga lngas brgyan pa shar ba'i steng phyogs su 'od lnga ldan rma bya'i gdugs ltar bkra ba zhig kyang 'char te/ 'di dag la ni rdo rje sems dpa'i khong seng gi lam zhes kyang bya ste/ ye shes bzhi sbyor gyi 'od lam yin no// 'od lam ljang gu mi snang ba ni nyams len gyi rtsal ma rdzogs pas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mi snang bar gsungs so// de nas ye shes lhun grub rig 'dzin la thim pa zhes bya ba gong gi 'od snang de dag steng gi 'od lnga gdugs ltar snang ba de nyid la 'dus te slar rang snang gi steng thams cad du ka dag rig stong mtshon pa'i nam mkha' sprin bral lta bu chos sku'i snang ba dang*/

bar du lhun grub gzugs sku khro bo'i zhing dang zhi ba'i zhing khams/ rang bzhin sprul pa'i sku'i zhing khams bye brag sogs thams cad snang la/ 'og tu ma dag rigs drug 'jig rten gyi bkod pa thams cad kyang dus gcig tu snang ba me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar bkra gsal le 'char zhing*/ 'di skabs su gang zag de la mngon par shes pa lnga dang*/ rjes su dran pa drug /mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang*/ rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang rang bzhin gyis 'char ba chos nyid yin la/ gzhan yang sngar shes pa dang mi shes pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs mang po yang rgyud la 'char bar gsungs te/ mdor na 'di dag gi skabs gang dang gang la gdams pa'i gnad dran cing nyams len gyis slebs na nges par grol la/ gal te goms shugs chung bas ma grol na srid pa bar do rmi lam gyi snang ba tsam zhig mthong nas/ slar rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs dbyung ste/ sa lam rnams myur du bgrod pas 'tshang rgya bar gsungs so/ ༈ /da ni chos nyid kyi bar do 'di dag lam du khyer tshul ji ltar bya ba ni/ de yang dang po 'chi kha bar do nas bzung ste 'di yan chad la yun ring thung ji tsam gnas snyam na/ da lta 'char tshul bshad pa'i skabs 'dir tshig gi brjod rgyu mang zhing kha thag ring ba lta bu 'dis/ bar do 'di rnams kyang 'char yun ring mo yod 'dra ba yod na'ang*/ don la ni/ de ltar mi 'gor te/ thog mar thim rim phyi nang rnams kyang gang zag so so'i rtsa khams dang nad rkyen gyi bye brag gis gcig tu ma nges mod kyang phal cher la ni yud tsam re las med cing*/ khyad par du dkar lam dmar lam nag lam rnams kyang bya rdzogs kyi skad cig re las mi gnas par gsungs la/ de nas 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku lhan skyes kyi ye shes shar ba de yang gang zag phal pa sogs nyams len med pa kun la ni se gol gyi yun tsam las mi gnas pa mang la/ la lar zan za yun tsam gnas thub pa yang yod pa dang*/

nyams len cung zad yod pa'i rigs la ni da lta mnyam bzhag dngos gzhi'i ngang la ji tsam rang dbang thob pa de dang mthun par gnas pa bsam gtan gyi zhag ces bya ba de nyid gcig nas lnga'i bar ci rigs gnas par gsungs/ yang rnal 'byor pa rtogs pa'i gding ldan dag ni 'od gsal gyi ngang der yun ji tsam 'dod pa mnyam par 'jog thub cing*/ de lta bu dag la ni mthar ye shes kyi rlung gis rig pa spyi gtsug tu bton te yar gyi zang thal chen po 'grub la/ de'i rtags su byang sems dkar po spyi bo'am sna bug g.yon nas 'thon pa 'byung ba dang*/

g.yon du ye shes kyi rlung rgyu ba'i gnad kyis yin no// 'pho ba thebs pa tshul ldan gyi rtags la'ang byang sems 'thon lugs 'di bzhin 'byung gi/ deng sang gi 'pho ba thebs yod zer ba phal che bar rtags 'di ma byung ba mang bas thebs ma thebs the tshom mo// yang 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan bzang po sogs mkhas grub 'ga'i gsung las ni/ phung po las rnam shes ma thon par yun ring sdod pa thams cad rang ni thugs dam la bzhugs pa tshul ldan yin par ma nges te/ gang zag la la phung po la sems chags nas sdod pa dag kyang yod/ ces gsungs la/ gang ltar yang mchog dman gang la'ang khams dkar dmar steng 'og gi sgor ma 'thon pa'i bar la ni phung po sreg sbyong sogs gtan nas mi rung ba nyid de/ ci'i phyir na/ thugs dam la bzhugs pa yin na ni de'i bar chad du 'gyur la/ phal pa ro la chags pa yin pa'i tshe na'ang rnam shes ma 'thon tshe gsod pa dang mtshungs par 'gyur bas so// de nas rdzogs chen ltar gyi lhun grub 'od gsal gyi snang ba de dag kyang*/ goms pa cung zhig yod pa dag la ni rang nyid kyi goms cha dang mtshungs pa'i bsam gtan gyi zhag re re nas lnga'i bar du 'char la/ goms med rnams la bya rdzogs kyi skad cig re las mi 'byung tshe ngos zin pa dka' zhing*/ la la ni sgra 'od zer gsum rang snang du ma shes par skrag pas brgyal thabs su zad do// de ltar 'phros don brjod nas/ skabs don gyi dngos gzhi ni/ de yang bar do dang po gzhi'i 'od gsal 'di zin cing grol bar byed pa'i thabs mchog ni/ da lta skye gnas bar do'i skabs 'dir sems kyi bdar sha legs par bcad cing*/ gnas lugs don dam tha mal shes pa bzo med rang babs chos sku khor yug gi nyams len bsgom yengs 'das pa la gnad du bsnun dgos pa kho na ste/ 'di la rkyen gyi sel dang blos byas yid byed kyi dri mas ma bslad par skyong shes na bar do dang po ma zad/

rnam pa kun tu gces pa'i snying po yin pa dang*/ mdo rgyud man ngag mtha' dag gi don snying bcud mchog mthar thug pa nyid do// brgyad khri bzhi stong gi chos thams cad 'dir 'dus shing rdzogs pas na rdzogs pa chen po/ thams cad sku gsum las 'da' ba med pas phyag rgya chen po/ blos byas thams cad las 'das pas na shes rab phar phyin/ mtha' thams cad dang bral bas dbu ma/ lam gyi mchog 'bras bu mngon du byed phyir lam 'bras/ nyon mongs rang sar zhi bas zhi byed/ gnyis snang gi zhen 'dzin rtsad nas gcod pas gcod yul/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la dngos su sbyor bas sbyor drug /ma rig 'khrul pa'i blo rtog sbyong bas blo sbyong sogs mdor na chos zab dgu'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pas dngos don gyi snying po ni 'di kho na las gzhan med phyir/ des na nges pa'i don la chig dril du mi 'bad na blo mang gi bya byed kyis dgos khar don mi 'grub ste/ kun byed rgyal po'i rgyud las/ rang sems de bzhin nyid 'di rtogs gyur na// sangs rgyas tshig gi lam la gnas min te// da lta nyid nas shin tu rnal 'byor thob// las med skal pa dman pa rnams la ni// gab pa mngon du phyung kyang mi go ste// gang zhig nor bu rin chen 'dod pa des// shing la byi dor byas pas mi 'byung zhing*// zhes pa ltar/ da lta nas ma nor ba'i don la brtson pa gal che zhing*/ bye brag tu chos drug dang thos grol sogs man ngag so so las 'byung ba ltar gyi 'od gsal sbyang ba'i rim pa rnams la'ang nan tan du byas la gnyid 'thug po'i skabs sogs la rtogs pa 'od gsal rang dbang thob na/ 'di skabs kyi gzhi'i 'od gsal zin par tshegs med cing*/ lar 'od gsal dang po zin thub mi thub kyi tshad ni da lta gnyid la dge sbyor slebs mi slebs kho nas shes pas/ de ltar na gong du bshad pa'i thugs dam la bzhugs pa dngos dang*/ phung po la chags nas sdod pa gnyis kyi dbye ba yang 'di kas shes mod cing*/

thugs dam la bzhugs pa tshul ldan snang na de ka'i gsal 'debs bzhin byed shes na ma gtogs/ gzhan ni mtshan bcas kyi 'pho ba'i rigs sogs kyang mi gdab ste/ mdor na 'di lta bu dag la ni slad du khrus chog byang bzhus sogs la'ang ltos mi dgos par grub bo// snang ba'i 'od gsal gyi ngo sprod ni/ thabs lam rim lnga sbyor drug sogs la 'dris pa'i gang zag la sngar ltar smig rgyu sogs dang dkar lam sogs gang shar thams cad rang rig chos sku'i mdangs las gzhan ma yin par ngo 'phrod dgos pa dang*/ rdzogs chen thod rgal ba rnams la ni sgra 'od zer gsum zhi khro'i lha dang*/ thig le zer thag 'od lam zhing khams ci shar mtha' dag rang mdangs kho nar yid ches shing thag chod pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa shin tu gces te/ de ltar bya nus pa'i thabs su da lta khregs chod gzhi'i gnas lugs la bdar sha chod cing*/ thod rgal lam gyi ngo sprod rnams gnad du thebs pas nyams su len dgos mod kyi deng sang gi skabs 'dir/ chos spyi pa rnams kyis ni bon dang rnying ma zhes tha snyad log pa'i lam du 'dzin pa ma gtogs chos kyi khyur yang mi 'jug la/ khyad par zab chos rdzogs pa chen po ni/ rgya gar du dga' rab 'jam dpal shrī singha dang mkhas pa nyer lnga sogs 'od lus 'grub pa mang mod kyi/ de dag gis ni gsang ba sbas pa'i tshul du thugs nyams su bzhes pa ma gtogs/ 'o skol bod kyi ltar khe grags rnyed 'tshol gyi zong du mi mdzad pas grags chung la/ rgyud sde 'bum phrag drug cu sogs phal cher gyi ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro dang rig 'dzin gyi gnas rnams su bzhugs phyir/ mi yul du bzhugs tshan chung ba dang*/ gangs can 'dir yang bstan pa snga dar gyi tshe o rgyan/ bi ma bai ro sogs kyi sku drin las skal ldan mang po 'od lus su grol zhing*/ snyan brgyud dang gter brgyud mang po deng sang gi bar du yod na'ang*/

'gos lha btsas dang*/ 'bri gung dpal 'dzin sogs kyis sna drangs bshes gnyen mang pos rdzogs chen rgya gar na deng sang mi 'dug pas bka' tshad ma min par bsgrubs pa dang ha shang gi lta ba yin pa skad du mdzad pa dang*/ bod kyi brtsams chos yin pa ru gsungs pa sogs kyi bka' bkyon sna tshogs pas dad can mang po nyams nyes par mdzad cing*/ bka' 'gyur dang rgyud 'bum sogs kyi khrod du dri tsam mnam dbang med par gyur pa'i mthus/ gang zag phal cher ni rdzogs pa chen po sogs yo ga rnam gsum gyi chos la nad ngan gyis shi ba'i ro mthong ba bzhin du 'dzem par byed la/ rnying lugs par khas 'che ba dag ni srung zlog mthu gtad sogs kyis yid drangs shing*/ rang 'khor bu smad gso phyir grong chog rnyed 'tshol dang skyur 'byams la nyams len byed pa ma gtogs/ rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad don ni yid kyi rgu la'ang thos ma myong ba sha stag tu gyur tshe des ni gong gi 'phro ltar tshe 'dir 'od lus 'grub pa'am 'od gsal dang por grol ba ni lta zhog /chos nyid bar do ngo shes pa'i go rtogs 'jags pa tsam yong ba'i go skabs kyang mi snang bar gsal te/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa chen pos/ tshos rdzogs pa chen po yin pas mi phan/ gang zag rdzogs pa chen por song ba zhig dgos/ zhes gsungs pa shin tu bden par zad do// de ltar snang lugs kyi drang gtam 'phros don du brjod nas/ 'di skabs kyi dngos don la/ de yang rdzogs chen gyi rang gzhung so so nas 'byung ba ltar gyi khregs chod la/ ngo rang thog tu 'phrod pa/ thag gcig thog tu chod pa/ gding grol thog tu bca' ba rnams dang*/ thod rgal la sgron ma drug gi rang bzhin gtan la phabs te/ mi 'gul ba gsum la gzhi bca' ba/ sdod pa gsum gyis tshad bzung ba/ thob pa gsum gyis gzer gdab pa/ gding bzhis grol tshad bstan pa sogs thams cad kha tshig la ma 'byams par don rgyud thog tu khel na snang ba bzhi mthar phyin te/

rab kyis phung po zag med 'od skur grol ba dang*/ 'bring gis sum chag nam mkha' phyi nang 'dres pa bzhin gzhi'i 'od gsal la btsan sa zin pas seṅge mngal rgya dang khyung sgong rgya grol ba lta bu/ rnam smin lus rgya grol ba dang sems chos sku 'grub pa dus mnyam du 'byung*/ tha ma yang chos nyid bar do lhun grub gzugs sku'i 'od gsal shar tshe/ 'od gsal zung 'jug la thim dus su 'jug pa shes pa'i gnad dang ldan pa dang*/ zung 'jug ye shes la thim tshe grol ba lus kyi gnad dang*/ lhun grub rig 'dzin la thim dus mthar phyin ngo shes kyi gnad rnams gal che zhing*/ lhun grub kyi skabs 'dir rgyud las kyang*/ lhun grub rig pa'i 'char tshul ni// rnam pa brgyad du shar ba'o// zhes pa bzhin rig pa'i mdangs nyid thugs rje ltar shar ba dang*/ 'od ltar shar ba dang*/ sku ltar shar ba dang*/ ye shes ltar shar ba dang*/ gnyis med ltar shar ba/ mtha' grol ltar shar ba/ ma dag 'khor ba'i sgo ltar shar ba/ dag pa ye shes kyi sgo ltar shar ba ste/ de dag la gdams pas zin na thim lugs kyang rnam pa brgyad 'byung ste/ thugs rje thim pas 'khor ba'i sems can rang snang du grol te 'khrul pa'i ming med pa dang*/ de bzhin du 'od thim pas mtshan ma'i kha dog sogs rigs can du ma grub pa'i chos dbyings su ro gcig pa dang*/ sku thim pas zhal phyag gi spros pa las 'das pa'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa dang*/ ye shes thim pas chos nyid ma bu 'dres pa dang*/ gnyis med thim pas stong chen ngo bo nyid du grol/ mtha' grol thim pas dmigs gtad kyi yul zad/ 'khor ba'i sgo thim pas skye gnas 'khrul pa'i yul rkyen bral/ dag pa ye shes kyi sgo ngo bo nyid skur thim pas ka dag chos zad blo 'das chen por sangs rgyas te/ nam mkha' klong yangs kyi rgyud chen las/ rnag can lus 'di ma bor bar// sangs rgyas yon tan ma snang ste// dper na khyung phrug sgo nga'i nang*// gshog drug rgyas par gyur mod kyang*// ma chag bar du 'phur mi nus// sgong 'chag 'phur shes dus mnyam 'byung*// de ni sangs rgyas yon tan yang*// da lta mi snang lus kyis bsgrib// rnam smin lus 'di bor ma thag

/sangs rgyas yon tan snang bar 'gyur// ces dang*/ dgongs pa thig 'debs las kyang*/ rtogs pa'i gding chen de ldan na// seṅge mchongs pas sa chod ltar// ye shes zang thal chen po yis// bar do med par skad cig la// rin chen sbubs su sangs rgyas 'gyur// ces sogs gsungs la/ grol tshad kyang nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rgyud las/ de ltar dbang po'i rim pa ni gsum ste/ rab ni skad cig ma gsum la grol bar 'gyur ro// 'bring ni bsam gtan gyi zhag lnga la grol ba yang yod do// skad cig nyi shu rtsa gcig la ni brtan pa thob nges pa yin no// dbang po tha ma rnams ni sprul pa sku'i zhing khams su dbugs dbyung nas bar do med par sangs rgyas pa'o// zhes gsungs te/ gtso bor da lta'i nyams len la rag las so// yang 'di skabs su gang zag la la'i bsam yul du rdzogs chen ma gtogs chos gzhan las ni bar do dang po'i 'od gsal ma zin na rnam shes 'thon te srid pa bar do 'char bar bshad pa las/ sgra 'od zer gsum zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'char tshul mi 'byung la/ gal te 'char ba yin na'ang rang rang gi chos lugs dang nyams len gang byed de'i lha tshogs shar na ma gtogs/ thams cad la rnying lugs kyi zhi khro 'char ba mi srid snyam pa sogs byed pa 'byung mod kyi/ de la spyir chos lugs so so'i lam rim man ngag gang yin de dang cha mthun par bar do'i gdams pa yang cha tshang 'byung mod la/ rang gi rgyud gzhung de ka'i dgongs don ltar nyams len gyi rtsal 'don phyogs kyang gang mang mchis te/ de yang 'ga' zhig bskyed rim gtso bor gsungs pa dang*/ la lar thabs lam bde stong gi nyams len la rtsal du bton pa dang*/ gzhan dag tu spros med kho nar dril bar gsungs pa sogs mtha' yas mod kyi/ da lta nyams len gang la goms pa des bar dor slebs dgos pa gzhir bcas kyang*/ rdzogs chen snying thig sogs ni khregs chod thod rgal zung 'jug tu nyams su len par gsungs pa'i skabs yin pas/

da lta de dag la goms tshe bar do yang de ltar 'char zhing*/ de la nyams len gyis slebs na grol bar yang gzhi grub la/ chos gzhan nas thod rgal gyi nyams len dngos su ma gsungs pas/ bar dor de dag 'char ba yang ma gsungs kyang*/ sgra 'od zer gsum ni rlung sems dbyer med dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi rkyen las nam yang 'char la/ de yang 'phrang sgrol chen po sogs las don gyi rtsa rlung thig le rnams ni nam du'ang 'bral ba med par gsungs pa'i gnad don dang*/ gzhan yang dus 'khor sbyor drug sogs ni rdzogs chen gyi snang mun nyams su len tshul dang mthun cing lha 'char ba rnams kyang 'gro ba'i phung po khams dbang skye mched thams cad gzod nas dkyil 'khor nyid du lhun gyis grub tshul ni rgyud sde kun mthun te/ phung po lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga dang*/ 'byung ba lnga yum lnga/ tshogs brgyad sems dpa' brgyad yul brgyad sems ma brgyad sogs ye nas yin tshe/ dam pa rigs brgyar bshad pa'i khongs su lha gzhan kyang ma 'dus su med pa dang*/ 'on kyang sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs mi gcig pa sna tshogs ni sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi dag sbyong so so la brten nas bshad pa ma gtogs/ don dam pa ni rang rig sku gsum dbyer med dam/ sku gnyis zung 'jug tu ma 'dus pa'i lha dang dkyil 'khor ni 'ga' yang med pa dang*/ rang rang gi bag chags goms 'dris kyi mthu las ni dam pa rigs brgyar ma zad gzhan 'char ba yang ma nges la/ sdig can la gshin rje'i skyes bur snang yang rang nyid kyi las snang du zad mod/ don la ni gang dang gang ltar shar yang rang snang nyid du shes dgos pa ni gnad dam pa'o// gzhan yang ji skad du sdom 'byung las/ rnal 'byor pa rnams 'pho ba'i tshe// khrag 'thung la sogs rnal 'byor mas// me tog sna tshogs lag na thogs// rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang*// rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs kyis// 'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog ste// mkha' spyod gnas su khrid par byed// ces gsungs pa 'di'ang rnying lugs kyi chos nyid bar do dang dgongs pa mthun par snang ngo*// lar cir snang lha dang bla ma'i rol pa dang*/

de yang rang rig dang gnyis med ro mnyam chen por rtogs pa'i gang zag la ni 'di phyi bar do khyad med du chos nyid bde ba chen po'i zhing las ma g.yos mod kyi/ gzhan ni mkha' spyod glu phreng du/ mdang rmi lam gnyid kyi 'khrul lugs kyis// sang bar do 'byongs par dka' mor mchi// zhes gsungs pa 'di kho na nyid de/ da lta lus ngag yid rnams lhan cig rang dbang thob dus 'dir/ 'khrul pa a 'thas yang 'thas la zhen pas nyin mtshan 'da' lugs 'di 'dra la 'chi dus gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal dang 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang rlung ltar 'tshubs dus de 'drar thugs dam gyi slebs re a thang chad par gda' bas/ des na gtan gyi don chen da lta nas grabs tshud cig cis kyang dgos par sems so// 'dir smras pa/ gzhi bde gshegs snying po'i gnas lugs dang*// lam rang byung chos sku'i rang 'gros dang*// 'bras dri bral mngon gyur sangs rgyas gsum// don dbyer med da lta'i rig pa gcig /de yin kyang dbul po'i khyim gter bzhin// dus thog med da bar ngo ma shes// des shes kyang rang babs mi skyong bar// blo 'khrul zhen mang pos bslad pas phung*// de yin lugs kyi rang ngo rig thog tu// sgom blos byas kyi 'jur bus ma bcings par// sems gang shar gyi ngo bo yengs med skyong*// des bar do kun btsan chod du 'gyur te mchi// zhes pa yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ ༈ /don bzhi pa srid pa las kyi bar do'i rang bzhin 'chad pa la'ang gsum gyi dang po ngo bo ngos bzung ba ni/ de yang rdzogs chen gyi rnal 'byor pa rab 'bring rnams ni sngar bshad pa'i bar do gong ma de dag tu grol la/ tha ma'i rnal 'byor tshe 'dir ngo sprod kyi sgo mthong yang grol bar ma nus pa dag srid pa bar do'i snang ba rmi lam tsam zhig mthong bas rkyen byas te/ sngar gyi gdams pa dran pa'i mthu dang chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing du pad+ma las brdzus te skyes nas rmi lam sad pa ltar dran pa'i ting 'dzin rnyed par 'gyur te/

shar mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du mi bskyod pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi sprul pa'i zhal mthong*/ lho dpal dang ldan par rin chen rigs kyi sprul pas dbang bskur/ nub pad+ma brtsegs par 'od dpag med kyi sprul pas lung bstan/ byang las rab grub par 'phrin las rigs kyi sprul pas bag chags sbyangs/ dbus phyogs 'khor ba yongs sgrol gyi zhing du dpal he ru ka khro bo 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du shes bya'i sgrib pa phra mo tshun chad zad par byas te/ lo lnga brgya na chos sku ka dag chen por sangs rgyas shing sprul pa du mas 'gro ba'i don byed la/ gang zag 'ga' zhig ni phyogs bzhi'i zhing khams de dag gang rung gcig kho nar dbang bskur lung bstan dbugs dbyung thob nas sangs rgyas pa dag kyang 'byung ba ste/ mdor na 'di'i rigs kyi gang zag de la ni srid pa bar do'i snang ba yud tsam 'char yang*/ de'i sdug bsngal rnams mi myong zhing mngal sgor mi 'jug par zhing khams zin pa yin tshe srid pa bar do dngos su mi bzhed de/ rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor las/ 'di mthong dbang po tha ma la// bar ma do nyid snang 'gyur ram// 'on te mi snang ba 'am ci// ston pas gsungs pa de snang ste// rang gar 'dzin pa'i bag chags zad// rang bzhin sprul par dbugs phyung ste// bar do med par sangs rgyas nyid// ces gsungs la/ srid pa bar do dngos de gang yin ce na/ lus sems gyes nas chos nyid 'od gsal sgra 'od zer gsum sogs rang ngo ma shes pas yal zhing*/ 'khrul pa'i bag chags langs pa nas mgo bzung ste/ phyi ma'i mngal du ma chud kyi bar skabs de dag srid pa las kyi bar do zhes zer ba'o// gnyis pa de dag 'char tshul rgyas par bshad pa la/ de yang gang zag tha mal pa rnams gdams pa zab mo'i gnad dang ni ma ldan/ las sgrib shas che bas 'pho ba'i man ngag sogs kyi mtshams sbyor dang rten 'brel 'grigs pa yang dka' la/ gal te 'pho ba btab kyang nges shes dang goms 'dris med tshe dmigs yul der 'pho thub pa yang shin tu dka' ba'i dbang gis thog mar thim rim rnams kyi zug rngu nyams su myong zhing slar gzhi'i 'od gsal 'char ba de la phal pa dag rnam shes brgyal ba zhes kyang zer la/

rang ngo ma shes pas brgyal ba lta bu zhig byas nas mthar khams dkar dmar steng 'og gi sgo gnyis su 'thon skabs rnam shes nyid kyang las rlung gis bskyod de sgo dgu gang rung gcig tu 'thon par 'gyur la/ 'di dus chos nyid kyi rang sgra la ni dngangs/ 'od gsal gyi snang ba la ni skrag /thugs rje'i zer thag la ni 'bros/ ye shes rang byung gi lha tshogs la ni gshin rje'i las mkhan du mthong bas 'jigs/ lhun grub rin po che'i zhing gi bkod pa 'khor 'das kyi snang ba thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar bkra lam me mthong yang*/ yar sku gsum dag pa'i zhing khams rnams la ni mig gis blta yang mi phod/ mar rigs drug 'khor ba'i snang tshul dag la sngar zhen gyi bag chags ngan goms mthu brtas pa'i dbang gis yid 'jug par byed do// de yang sngar rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dang 'byung ba'i rlung rnams gzhi la thim pa'i gnad kyis/ rang bzhin gnas lugs kyi 'od gsal rnams shar yang ngo ma shes pa'i mthus/ da ni slar ma rig pa khyab byed kyi rlung las/ rlung gi rlung tshur byung*/ de las me'i rlung dang*/ de las chu rlung*/ de las sa rlung byung ste/ 'khor bar 'du byed pa dang rnam par shes pa gsal du gsal du song bas gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun po langs/ de las kyang 'khrul rtog rag tu rag tu song bas 'dod chags kyi rtog pa bzhi bcu dang*/ zhe sdang gi rtog pa so gsum po thams cad langs shing*/ khams lnga'i rlung dang rnam shes zung 'brel du grub pa'i mthu las yid kyi lus dbang po kun tshang ba'i snang ba can gcig tu shar te/ lus la 'od cung zad dang ldan pa zas su dri za zhing gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes phra mo yod pa/ ma'i mngal dang rdo rje gdan ma gtogs stong gsum kun tu yid la bsam pa tsam gyis bgrod thub pa/ mngon shes can dang rang gi rigs mthun bar do'i 'gro ba rnams phan tshun mthong la lus can gzhan gyis mi mthong ba de lta bur krongs kyis gyur te/

de skabs ni rang gi sngar gyi ro sogs mthong yang da dung rang nyid shi ba ni mi shes la/ rang gi khang khyim nor rdzas yo byad sogs la zhen pa chen pos bdag tu gzung bar byed cing*/ grogs dang nye 'khor rnams kyis rang nyid kyi dngos po longs spyod pa sogs la 'phang sems dang khong khro sngon las rag pa mang po byed kyang khong rnams kyis ni mi shes/ nang gi dwangs ma khams dkar dmar med pa'i gnad kyis phyi rol gang du phyin kyang nyi zla'i snang ba med pa dang*/ bkres skom gyis rab tu gdungs kyang bza' btung ma bsngos pa la spyod dbang med pa dang*/ rten gzhi lus dngos med pa'i gnad kyis bya sgro rlung khyer ltar rang dbang med par yad yud phyad phyod du 'khyams shing sdug bsngal tshor ba gzhan las rag pa 'byung*/ gzhan yang de'i tshe ma nges pa'i rtags drug 'char te/ gnas la nges pa med par yud tsam rang la 'pho 'gyur byed cing*/ khang stong grog po phug rdug brag phug sogs nges med du sdod par snang ba dang*/ rten pa nges med zug rngu'i ngal stegs mchod rten rtsa brgyad la sogs brten pa dang*/ spyod pa nges med skad cig re la sna tshogs byed pa dang*/ kha zas nges med rigs drug gi zas bzang ngan sna tshogs mthong yang ma bsngos par mi thob pa dang*/ grogs nges med lha dang 'dre srin bar do'i sems can sna tshogs dang yud re 'phrad cing 'grogs/ snang tshul nges med yid kyi 'char sgo bde sdug rnam pa sna tshogs skad cig re la 'gyur ldog byed cing*/ 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang la mi 'byung ba'i sna med pa mang po 'char bar 'gyur ro// gzhan yang 'jigs pa'i dgra bzhi zhes bya ba/ sa rlung log pa'i rkyen gyis rang snang du ri nyil ba'am khang pa rdib pa'i 'og tu tshud pa'i snang ba dang*/ chu rlung log pas chu chen po'i klong du khyer ba'am/ mtsho chen du bying ba'i nyams snang dang*/ me rlung log pas nags tshal lam khang khyim tshig pa'i dkyil du bsreg pa'i snang ba dang*/

rlung gi rlung log pas rlung 'tshub drag pos khyer ba'i snang ba sogs 'byung zhing nyon mongs dug gsum gyi bag chags rang gzugs las grub pa'i ya nga ba'i g.yang sa chen po dkar dmar nag gsum snang ba ru lhung ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ char lhag gis brdung ba dang*/ rnag khug gi ser ba 'babs pa dang*/ sha za srin po gcan gzan 'jigs rung mang pos 'ded pa'i snang ba dang*/ khyad par nya pa rngon pa bshan pa sogs tshe 'dir sdig chen gyi las gang dang gang la bsags pa de dang de dag mang pos tshur brdeg brdung gsod gcod kyi 'khrul snang shas cher 'byung la/ mdor na bdun phrag gcig nas zhe dgu'i bar ram/ la la dag lo zla'i bar du mar srid pa bar do'i sdug bsngal myong ba'ang yod la/ phal cher ni bdun zhag ma tshang gi ring la sdod pa shas che zhing*/ zhag bdun bdun la 'chi theng re byed pa'i snang ba dang*/ zug rngu'i tshor ba nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba dang*/ mdor na bar do 'dir ji tsam gnas pa'i phyed ni da lta'i lus dang skye ba de'i bag chags byed cing*/ phyed phan chad nas skye ba rjes ma de'i snang ba shas cher 'gyur ba'o// phyed tsam de shed du gshin yul skya mo'i gling na/ gshin rje chos rgyal la las mkhan 'jigs su rung ba mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i mdun du slebs nas/ lhan skyes kyi lha dang 'dres rde'u dkar nag bshar te dge sdig gi shan 'byed byed pa'i snang ba yang 'byung bar bshad la/ lar phyed mtshams phan chod de nas brtsams te/ las rlung dang dug lnga'i bag chags kyi rten 'brel rang mdangs las rigs drug gi skye gnas kyi snga rtags su rnam byang 'od kyi lam lnga gang rung 'byung ste/ de yang lhar skye na 'od lam dkar po bkrag med kyi snang ba dang*/ de bzhin du lha ma yin la dmar po/ mi la sngon po/ dud 'gro la ljang gu/ yi dwags la ser skya rnams 'char la/ dmyal bar skye ba'i las can yin na mar gyi zang thal ma gtogs 'di skabs su sdod pa mi 'byung bar yang gsungs shing*/

gzhung la lar ni 'od lam dud kha la zin na dmyal bar skye ba yang bshad pas nges pa med par mngon cing*/ yang thos grol las ni/ 'od lam 'di dag gong gi ye shes bzhi sbyor gyi 'od dang rigs lnga'i lha tshogs shar skabs su lhan cig 'byung bar gsungs pa ni gang zag gi rigs la dgongs pa yang yin mod kyi/ lar yang nyon mongs pa dug lnga po lam ma lhongs shing ma rtogs pa'i ngor ni 'gro drug gi lam snang dang skye gnas rnams 'char la/ de dag ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor rnams kyi ngor ye shes 'od lnga dang rgyal ba rigs lngar shar nas de dag gi ngo bor grol ba la dgongs shing*/ gzhan yang de skabs su thos grol sogs las/ zhag dang por rgyal ba mi bskyod pa gtso 'khor rnams 'char ba dang*/ gnyis pa la rin 'byung sogs zhag grangs rim pa lta bur dgongs can du gsungs pa 'di la nyin zhag dngos yin par bsam mkhan mang yang ma yin te/ 'di ni gong du brjod pa bzhin bsam gtan gyi zhag yin tshe phal pa rnams la yud tsam zhig las mi 'char bar shes par bya'o// de ltar gong gi 'phro bzhin rnam byang lnga gang rung la zin par gyur tshe rang nyid shi ba yang shes la/ bar do'i yid lus des rab tu skyo ste skye gnas 'tshol ba'i 'dun pa kho na byed par 'gyur zhing*/ de'i dbang gis rigs drug gang du skye 'gyur gyi las yod pa de dang de'i snang ba so sor 'char ba ste/ lhar skye na gzhal yas khang du 'gro ba'i snang ba dang*/ lha ma yin la 'od kyi 'khor lo lta bu'am/ 'ga' zhig la ni dmag 'khrug gi dkyil du 'gro ba'i snang ba 'byung*/ brag phug gam grog stong 'jag spyil sogs su mthong na byol song dang*/ sdong dum dang nags khrod dam re phyar gyi snang ba lta bus yi dwags dang*/ dmyal ba la ni sa dong nag por dbang med du 'khrid pa dang*/ lcags kyi grong khyer lta bur 'gro ba'i snang ba dang*/

la la zhig la ni glu dbyangs dang rtsed 'jo dang grogs mdza' bas 'bod par/ snang ba la zhen nas phyin pas dmyal bar skye ba yang yod do// mi rnams la ni so sor snang tshul sna tshogs te ngang pa pho mos brgyan pa'i mtsho mthong na shar gyi lus 'phags gling du skye ba dang*/ rta pho mo rgyu ba'i mtsho las byang sgra mi snyan dang*/ ba lang gis brgyan pa'i mtsho las nub ba lang spyod dang*/ 'dzam gling 'dir yang na bun lta bu'i gseb tu 'gro ba snyam byed na mi khom pa'i gnas sogs mi lus tsam po bar skye la/ khang bzang grong khyer dang skye bo mang po'i khrod du phyin pa'i snang ba las mi lus rin po che thob par 'gyur ba ste/ der pha ma chags spyod mthong tshe rang nyid pho mo gang du 'gyur ba de dang mthun pa'i pha ma so so la mig ser dang chags sems skyes pa'i rkyen gyis mtshams sbyar te mngal du 'jug par 'gyur la/ gzhan du rdzus skyes drod gsher skyes pa sogs kyi rigs rnams kyang gnas de nyid la chags sdang gi rnam rtog gang rung zhig gis rkyen byas nas zhugs par 'gyur ba nyid do// gsum pa gdams ngag gi lam khyer bshad pas 'gag bsdu ba ni/ de lta bu nyam nga zhing 'jigs su rung ba'i sdug bsngal zo chu'i khyud mo lta bur yang yang rgyun mi chad du 'khor bar 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi 'khor lo 'di da res nas rgyun chod pa zhig cis kyang dgos phyir/ gong du yang yang brjod pa ltar gdams pa'i gnad la da lta nas goms dgos shing*/ mchog tu rang sems la rang dbang thob pa'i nyams len dran rig dang ma bral na gdams pa 'di kho nas chog gis/ o rgyan rin po che nyid kyi zhal nas/ de yang bar do'i skabs su skad cig ma la ngos zin tsam gyis brtan pa thob pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ da lta ni sems rig las rlung gi rgyar 'thums/ las rlung gdos bcas sha khrag gi rgyar 'thums pas rang dbang ma thob la/

lus 'di bem rig bral nas phyi ma'i lus rgyar ma 'thums pa'i bar der rlung sems cho 'phrul dang bcas pa la dngos can gyi rten med cing*/ de la gdos bcas kyi rten med tshe rang dbang bsgyur te ngos zin/ ngos zin tsam des brtan pa thob nus pa ni/ dper na bskal pa'i bar gyi mun nag la/ sgron me slebs na skad cig la sel ba ltar 'gyur ba'o// bar dor da lta ngo sprod pa'i dus ltar zin na sangs rgya ba la the tshom med do// de bas da lta nas goms 'dris su bya'o// zhes gsungs so// khyad par du rmi lam dang bar do sbyang ba thams cad kyi gnad 'gag gtso bor 'dun pa kho na gal che che/ de la ni da lta ci byed thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma'i tshul dang*/ bdag shi nas bar dor slebs 'dug /snang ba ci shar 'di thams cad bar do'i snang ba yin/ 'di la nyams len gyi gnad 'di dang 'di bzhin bya snyam pa'i dran 'dun bar ma chad pa yod na bar do mi 'byong ba'i thabs med kyang*/ gang zag phal mo che kun da lta'i snang ba 'di bden bden pa yin no// mngon sum yin no// ma shi ba yin no snyam pa'i zhen pa a 'thas su byed lugs 'di 'dras ni bar do zin pa'i thabs rtsa ba nas zad mod kyi/ lar tshe 'di'i zhen pa can la chos gang yang lam du 'gro ba gang nas kyang ma gsungs so// des na rje mi las/ nga 'chi ba kho nas 'jigs 'jigs nas// sems 'chi med gnyug ma'i ngang du sbyangs// 'khor ba rang grol gzhi yi gnas// snying po'i don la ngo sprod gyis// nang rig pa rten med gcer bu 'di// 'gyu ba dwangs pa lta ba'i gdengs// 'od gsal stong pa blo thag chod// da skye shi gnyis la nyam nga med// ces gsungs pa ltar 'bad dgos shing*/ bye brag tu de skabs su rnam byang gi 'od gsal ma zin tshun chod ni/ 'jigs skrag gi snang ba ci shar mtha' dag rang sems kyi 'char sgo ru thag chod pa ni thams cad du gces la/

khyad par mnyam med sgam po pa'i man ngag dgra bzhi lam 'khyer sogs kyang 'di dus mchog tu gal che bar mngon cing*/ gal te rang nyid rmi lam gyi gdams ngag la rtsal 'thon pa zhig yin pa'i tshe na/ da lta rmi lam sprul sgyur rtsal sbyong rnams dang khyad par dag pa zhing sbyong sogs la goms tshe/ de dag gi gnad don dran pa tsam gyis gang 'dod 'grub la/ gong du rdzogs chen gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams la dbang thob cing der khyad par gyi sa lam sbyangs te/ myur du byang chub chen po mngon du 'gyur bar tshegs med pa dang*/ mkha' spyod zhing gi 'pho ba sogs 'byongs kyang 'di dang mtshungs so// de dag gang la'ang da lta'i bag chags ngan goms kyi mthus zang zing gnyen 'khor sogs la chags zhen dang shul gyi bya byed bzang ngan gyi tshogs gang mthong la chags sdang gi rtog pa ma zhugs pa ni nan tar gal che bar 'gyur tshul gyi lo rgyus gtam rgyud sogs shin tu mang bar mdo sogs las 'byung phyir gang la yang ma chags par nyams len la rtse gcig tu 'bad pa dang*/ gal te rnam byang gi 'od gsal zin phyin chad/ de nas cung zad bzlog par dka' mod kyi/ 'on kyang de tshe skye ba phyi ma'i pha ma sogs yang srid kyi mtshams sbyor gang mthong yang rab kyis ni rig stong rdzogs chen nam/ bde stong phyag chen lhan skyes ye shes kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag na mngal sgo dgag pa'i thabs kyi mchog yin te/ 'di la ni 'jug byed kyi mkhan po dgag pa zhes bya la/ de tsam gyi nus pa med kyang bskyed pa'i rim pa rnam dag la nges shes rnyed pa zhig yin na ni/ dag pa'i sgyu lus sam snang stong zung 'jug ye shes kyi skur ldang nus na'ang*/ bar dor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub par gsar rnying thams cad las bshad cing*/ 'di la ni bskyed rim gyi brda don rtags gsum ji lta bar shes pas da lta nas sgom pa goms pa zhig dgos na'ang*/

deng sang ni dus dbang gis bskyed rim par rlom pa phal cher a 'thas sam kun brtags kyi bskyed rim la zhen pa chen pos bsgom zhing*/ de'i sgom pa yang tshe 'di'i nad gdon zhi byed dang*/ thun mong gi las tshogs phran bu 'grub pa'i nus pa 'byung du re ba'i bsam pa kho na ma gtogs/ rdzogs byang gi slad du lha sngags kyi nyams len dri med byed mkhan ni ches dkon pa snang tshe/ a 'thas kyi bskyed rim des ni bar dor grol ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba lta zhog /yi dwags yi dam gyi gzugs can du skyes tshul gyi gtam rgyud rnams dang mtshungs par sems la/ bskyed rim tshul bzhin shes pa zhig yin na pha ma sogs chags sdang mig ser gyi yul rkyen gang mthong de dag yi dam yab yum du bsgom pas kyang sgo 'gag pa'i thabs mchog tu'ang 'gyur la/ gal te bsam bzhin du mi lus chos ldan gyi skye ba len par spro na'ang rang dang pha ma lhar bskyed cing*/ mngon byang lnga dang cho ga gsum sogs kyi ting 'dzin dang ldan pas mngal du zhugs na/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i don 'grub par 'gyur ba'o// yang gal te rang nyid bslab pa rin po che la gces spras su byed pa'i dge sbyong zhig yin pa'i tshe na srid pa'i mtshams sbyor gyi pha ma mthong ba de'i tshe rang nyid kyi tshul khrims la 'dun pa rtse gcig dang ldan pas chags sdang gi snang ba dang bsam sbyor ring du spangs la/ zhen log nges 'byung gi yid brtan po dang ldan pas kyang 'khor ba'i gnas ngan gyi sgo khegs par nus pas/ de lta bu'i zhe bcad la goms pa'i blo yang da lta nas bslab sbyangs dang*/ gzhan yang nyams len de dag gang yang med kyang bar do'i 'jigs skrag gis dbang med du ded cing skye gnas ngan pa dag tu 'khrid pa byed dgos pa ltar byung tshe/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la ra mdar sbron cing skyabs su song ste rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab na de dag gi thugs rje bslu med kyi mthus 'jigs skrag las grol zhing dal 'byor chos ldan gyi lus blangs te ring por mi thogs par byang chub thob par 'gyur ba ste/

de ltar 'og ma 'di dag la ni 'jug yul gyi skye sgo dgag pa zhes bya ba'i thabs dang*/ khegs par ma nus na/ skye gnas 'dams pa'i thabs sogs bstan pa ste/ mdor na bar do'i gdams ngag gi skabs don gal che ba thams cad 'di dag yan la tshang bar mchis shing gzhan gang zag phal pa spyi la 'chi khar gzhog g.yas sa la phab pa'i spyi bo nas sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags byin rlabs can bsgrags pa dang*/ man ngag 'ga' zhig las 'byung ba bzhin rdzas kyi 'pho ba dang*/ byin rlabs dam rdzas sogs mdor na ngan 'gro las skyob thabs kyi rten 'brel du ma dang*/ shul du yang rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rnam dag dang*/ bde gshegs kyi gsung sgrog khrus chog dbang bskur byang bu bzhu ba sogs kyi rim pa rnams kyang ci ltar 'dzom pa bgyis na/ rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel bslu med dang*/ rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang chos nyid kyi bden pas phan pa rlabs po cher 'gyur ba gzhir bcas la/ 'on kyang cho ga sogs byed pa po rnams ting 'dzin tshul dang ldan pa shes mi shes ji ltar yang rung*/ log pa'i bsam sbyor sogs tshul ma yin pa'i byed spyod las ni tshe 'das de yi mngon par shes pas mthong ba'i rkyen byas te mtshams sbyor lam min du 'gro ba'i nyen 'byung tshe lhag bsam dag pa gal che ba dang*/ khyad par gshin po la dmigs pa'i dge ba mchod sbyin sogs la bsnyad nas srog gcod byed pa sogs ni phan pa bas gnod pa chen por 'gro bar mdo rgyud kun nas gsungs phyir/ shul du dge ba che chung gang byed sdig dang ma 'dres pa kho na gal che mod kyi/ gang zhig nyams len zab mo'i sgor zhugs pa'i gang zag rnams ni shi ba'i shul du dge ba byed kyang rung mi byed kyang rung ste/ rang nyid de dag la re mi dgos tsam zhig da lta nas mi byed na chos pa'i dgos pa med par 'gyur te/ o rgyan gyis gsungs pa ltar/

ma shi'i gong nas dam chos rem las gyis// mtshan byang mgo la dbang bskur byed tshe phyis// rnam shes bar dor khyi ltogs bzhin du 'khyams// mtho ris dran te de la dka' las yod// ces gsungs pa dang*/ zhang rin po ches/ rmas nas go cha bskyal ba dang*// 'chi khar sdig la 'gyod pa dang*// shi nas ro la dbang bskur gsum// yin dang yin te ma phyis sam// zhes gsungs pa ltar 'gyur bas/ des na lus thog 'di la 'bung dgos shing*/ gcig dril du nyams su len nus na chos kyi thabs mi 'gags te/ pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ chos ma shes nas phung ba min te/ ma nus pas phung ba yin/ yig drug mi shes mkhan ga la 'ongs te/ de yang 'dren mi nus par 'dug mod/ ces gsungs phyir nges shes dang ldan pas 'bad dgos te/ dam pa kun dgas/ nges shes skyes na gdams par ma gyur med// snyan brgyud gud du ma 'tshol ding ri ba// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang nyid gang la mos shing goms pa de la nyams len gnad du bsnun nas/ rab 'chi ba la brod pa/ 'bring mi 'tsher ba/ tha ma yang mi 'gyod tsam zhig byed pa ni gal po che'i gnad kyi gdams pa'o// kye ma thog med da lta'i bar du 'khor ba'i mtshor// rtag tu bying yang da dung mi skyo bar// tshe 'di'i 'dun ma sgrub pa'i chos gzugs bdag /blo rgyud dge la sgyur mdzod dkon mchog rnams/ 1 /chos min ched du lus srog cir mi sems// chos kyi phyir du dka' ba gcig mi bzod// snying stobs go log smyon pa chur mchong 'dra'i// chos pa'i zol gyis sa steng khyab la gzigs/ 2 /bstan par rlom yang bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren cing*// btsun par bcos kyang mi dges rgyud khengs pa// dug tsher dar gyis bstum 'dra'i mang lugs 'di// thub bstan nyi ma'ang gshegs pa'i thun 'od tsam/ 3 /dal 'byor la kha'i na bun yal la khad// mi tshe ri gzar 'bab chu mgyogs lugs la// lo brgyar sdod 'dra'i shom ra mi khom gyis// 'chi grabs myur du chug dang nges par ran/

4 /mi khyur ma chud dogs pa'i 'dun gros dang*// rgas khar ltogs kyis dogs pa'i rgyags grabs dang*// tha snyad shes rgya 'dod pa'i slob gnyer sogs// gang yang byed pa'i khom long da mi gda'/ 5 /kye ho// sna tshogs snang ba rmi lam lta bu 'di// bden med sgyu ma rang snang nyid shes pa// gang la'ang 'dzin med rang rig blo 'das skyongs// skye gnas bar do'i nyams len snying po lags/ 6 /myur du 'chi nges gang gis phan par dka'// 'chi bar snang ba'ang rang gi rnam rtog tsam// rnam rtog bzo med rang rig klong du skyur// 'chi kha bar do'i nyams len snying po lags/ 7 /snang dang mi snang bzang ngan 'dzin pa sems// sems nyid chos sku'i rang rtsal cir yang 'char// shar la zhen rtog dgag sgrub mi bya ba// chos nyid bar do'i nyams len snying po lags/ 8 /'khor ba rang sems myang 'das rang gi sems// bde sdug 'khrul snang sems las gzhan ma grub// rang sems rang dbang rang gis bsgyur ba ni// srid pa bar do'i nyams len snying po lags/ 9 /rang rig sku gsum 'du 'bral ye med phyir// 'di phyi bar do'i mtshan mas rab dben kyang*// ma rtogs blo la bar do'i 'khrul pa shar// shar ba de ka lam du khyer ba gces/ 10 /rang snang sna tshogs rang la shar ba ni// spangs pas mi spangs bkag pas mi khegs kyang*// rang mtshang rig na 'khrul pa'i rgyu rkyen bral// 'gag don ma lus 'di nyid kho nar 'dus/ 11 /de phyir dam pa'i bla ma legs bsten nas// chos kun mdo don snying por sgro 'dogs bcad// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// rang gzhan don gnyis myur 'grub 'bad par 'tshal/ 12 /gsang sngags nges pa don gyi snying po'i nyams len gnad// ma lus bar do'i gnas skabs bzhi 'dir 'dur rung bas// de dag dbye dang bsdu tshul gang yin smros shig ces// smon lam mtshan can gang gis bskul phyir 'di brjod mod/
